stories.title: Karni Sena youth district chief chased and beaten in Aligarh:Crowd slapped him, hit him with belts and made him chant ‘Jai Bhim’
stories.summary: A mob attacked Sachin Raghav, district president of the Kshatriya Yuva Karni Sena, in Aligarh. They chased him down the road, slapping him and hitting him with belts. During the assault, Sachin was seen pleading for forgiveness with folded hands. His younger brother and his brother's friend, who came to rescue him, were also beaten and injured. The attackers dragged Sachin inside Ambedkar Park. There, they made him raise slogans in honour of the Valmiki community and Dr Ambedkar. The attackers fled the scene as soon as they saw the police arrive following the report of the incident. The police sent Sachin to a government hospital for a medical examination. The incident took place at Ghantaghar intersection in the Civil Lines area. See two pictures... Sachin Raghav was eating chaat with his younger brother At around 6.30 p.m. on Wednesday, Sachin Raghav, the district president of the Kshatriya Yuva Karni Sena, was eating chaat near the Clock Tower. His younger brother Sundar and a friend were with him. Meanwhile, a mob of around 50 youths surrounded the two brothers. Chanting "Jai Bhim", the mob began beating Sachin. They attacked him with slaps and belts. When his brother tried to save him, they beat him too. Sachin said, “The attackers dragged me along the road from Ambedkar Park towards the SBI intersection. During this, they beat me with belts. The attackers also assaulted me inside the park.”

stories.title: 19-year-old Al-Qaeda-linked terrorist arrested:Used Instagram and WhatsApp to recruit ‘mujahids’, UP ATS nabs him in Tamil Nadu
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh ATS has arrested an al-Qaeda-linked terrorist from Coimbatore in Tamil Nadu. According to the ATS, 19-year-old Maqsood Ali was in contact with handlers based in Pakistan. He was involved in a conspiracy to carry out violent anti-national activities. He was recruiting young people into a radical ideology and preparing them to become mujahideen. Maqsood is originally from Madhwapur village in Siddharthnagar. After his arrest, the ATS brought him to Lucknow on transit remand. He was produced in court, and further legal proceedings are under way. He recruited young people through social media The Uttar Pradesh ATS claims that Maqsood had created groups on different social media platforms. Through these groups, he was recruiting young people for anti-national activities. He was influencing people with a radical ideology and turning them into mujahideen. He was also raising funds for this purpose so that they could receive training in the use of modern weapons. According to the ATS, the investigation also revealed that the module's links extended beyond other states in the country to suspected individuals based abroad. Was in contact with Pakistani handlers According to the ATS, Maqsood was developing hacking tools while staying in contact with handlers based in Pakistan. During questioning, he said that he had learnt about Python, Java, coding and hacking through online sources. Maqsood acquired technical information through Instagram, YouTube, Telegram and various WhatsApp groups. Created an application called 'Captain M Network' The investigation also found that Maqsood had developed a secure application called 'Captain M Network' to further his objective. Its purpose was to connect people through a platform. The ATS claims that Nabeel, Maqsood and others were in contact with one another through it. The investigation also uncovered details of several WhatsApp groups linked to Maqsood. These included groups named UU Entry Gate, United Ummah, Ghazwa-e-Hind, Team Black Hat and Lashkar-e-Mahdi. According to the ATS, suspects using Pakistani numbers and other Pakistani hackers were also members of these groups. Maqsood was also linked to Nabeel's group According to the ATS, Maqsood was also linked to a WhatsApp group called 'La Ghalib-Illallah', created by Mohammad Nabeel. Literature related to the banned terrorist organisation Al-Qaeda in the Indian Subcontinent (AQIS) and videos on bomb-making were being shared in the group. The ATS is now investigating Maqsood's digital network, foreign contacts, online activities and the role of other people linked through him. Nabeel was arrested in Azamgarh on 12 September The ATS arrested 19-year-old Mohammad Nabeel in Azamgarh on 12 September. He, too, is accused of spreading AQIS ideology and recruiting young people through social media. He was trying to influence young people with terrorist ideology through various WhatsApp groups. ATS officials had said that an investigation of Nabeel's mobile phone revealed information about a WhatsApp group involved in propagating AQIS ideology. One group's name is in Arabic. The ATS claims that people in the group were addressed as "mujahids".

stories.title: SP appoints new district presidents in 6 districts:Jai Singh in Ayodhya, Sunil Kumar Maurya in Ballia; full list
stories.summary: The Samajwadi Party announced the names of new district presidents in 6 Uttar Pradesh districts on Wednesday evening. The party leadership believes that assigning responsibility to new faces will bring fresh energy to the SP organisation. It will also help consolidate the vote bank at the local level. The names of the district presidents for Ayodhya, Ballia, Banda, Pilibhit, Gautam Buddh Nagar and Unnao were released after national president Akhilesh Yadav gave the go-ahead. Just a few days ago, the party had said that separate manifestos would be prepared for each district. Who has been given charge of which district? Read the full list... Caste balance taken into consideration in the list The Samajwadi Party leadership has made this reshuffle entirely keeping the electoral equations and caste balance in mind. The new district presidents will not only be responsible for strengthening the organisation down to the booth level, but will also have the primary responsibility of increasing the Samajwadi Party's support base in the 2027 Assembly election by coordinating among party workers. For the first time, a separate manifesto will be prepared for every district The Samajwadi Party's new strategy is aimed directly at building local-level engagement with voters. Instead of telling people during the election, "What will we do across the state?", the party will now speak directly about "What new things will we bring to your district?" The party's top leadership believes that Purvanchal, western Uttar Pradesh, Awadh and Bundelkhand each face different grassroots challenges. A common manifesto can accommodate only major state-level issues, leaving local concerns out. People will feel connected to the party only when the manifesto mentions basic problems in their areas, such as roads, water, electricity, healthcare, education and employment. Suggestion made at strategy meeting; Akhilesh approves it A high-level strategy meeting of all district presidents and office-bearers was held around two months ago in the presence of Akhilesh Yadav. The meeting saw a suggestion to include district-level issues in the manifesto, with the benefits of the move also being outlined. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav immediately gave the proposal the go-ahead. Following this, SP state president Shyamlal Pal issued a directive to all district presidents and office-bearers, asking them to prepare a complete account of their respective areas. The party leadership has asked all district presidents to prepare reports on the five biggest problems in their respective areas, stalled projects, and local employment opportunities.

stories.title: SP leader’s body placed on highway, barricades broken:‘Hang killers’ slogans raised in Prayagraj; family seeks govt job, ₹2 crore compensation
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party leader Pawan Yadav was murdered in Prayagraj on Tuesday. After the body reached home following the post-mortem at 4 p.m. on Wednesday evening, people erupted in anger. Hundreds of people gathered, placed the body on the road and blocked the Varanasi-Prayagraj National Highway. This led to long queues of vehicles on the highway and brought traffic to a complete standstill. During the protest, people raised slogans including "Down with the police administration" and "Hang the killers". The situation became more tense when the protesters broke through the police barricades placed on the highway. Some people also uprooted and threw away boards installed at the spot. As soon as they received the information, a team of police and administrative officials reached the spot and began trying to persuade the people. Amid the uproar, which continued for a long time, the officials assured them that strict action would be taken against the accused. At present, around 200 police personnel, 10 ACPs, forces from nine police stations and five PAC vehicles are deployed at the spot. Talks are under way with the body placed on the ground. The family members and villagers are insisting that the district magistrate be called. They are seeking a written assurance. They are insisting on a job for one member of the family and compensation of ₹2 crore. See 4 pictures... Two accused were shot in a police encounter in the afternoon Earlier, on Wednesday afternoon, police searching for the accused had an encounter with history-sheeters Lalla Yadav and Nihal in the Baraut area of Handia police station limits. Both sustained bullet wounds to their legs. Police arrested the two injured men along with the village head's husband and one other accused, taking the total number of arrests to four. Injured Lalla Yadav and Nihal have been admitted to the CHC in Handia. Meanwhile, the other arrested accused are being questioned. Police officers said all aspects related to the murder are being investigated. The police are also investigating the recovery of weapons and other evidence from the accused. Jitendra Yadav, alias Lalla, is a resident of Mugraon in the Handia police station area. More than 12 cases have been registered against him at several police stations in the district under serious charges, including murder, attempt to murder and robbery. According to police sources, Lalla was the one who shot Pawan Yadav. According to the police, the attackers arrived on a motorcycle. The youth sitting pillion shot Pawan. The investigation also revealed a possible old enmity. The police took action after examining footage from 42 CCTV cameras. A video has also emerged showing the attackers on the motorcycle. Based on this, the police detained Lalla Yadav, Brijesh Yadav and Nihal Ali. During questioning, it emerged that the three had arrived on a motorcycle to carry out the crime. Nihal was riding the motorcycle. Brijesh was seated in the middle and Lalla at the back. Lalla Yadav opened fire on Pawan Yadav. The motorcycle used in the incident and two country-made pistols have also been recovered. Both country-made pistols and the cartridges had been bought for ₹20,000. During questioning, it emerged that Pawan and Lalla had an old feud. Younger brother says: Bulldozers should be run over the accused's homes Pawan's younger brother, Brijesh Yadav, said, "Our elder brother has been murdered. When he left home, someone had called him. I do not know how he went to that place today when he did not usually go there. My brother had no enmity with anyone. He was a political figure. We now want justice. All those who are responsible for the murder and are roaming freely should be given the strictest punishment. Their homes should be bulldozed." SP spokesperson says, ‘Jungle raj in the state’ SP national spokesperson Nidhi Yadav said, "Today, you can see how such a major incident was carried out in Allahabad. Handia town is a bustling area. The president of the association of former village heads was murdered there in broad daylight. There is jungle raj in this state. This government cannot ensure anyone's safety." Now read the full details Pawan Yadav, who lives in Mugrawan village, had previously served as the village head. He is currently the Samajwadi Party's district secretary. Pawan was the youngest of two brothers. His family includes his wife, Neetu, three daughters-Khushi, Muskaan and Chhoti-and a son, Prince. At around 3 p.m. on Tuesday, Pawan reached Handia town in his car. He parked the car by the roadside in the Karmanasha locality. He then went to a nearby café to speak with friends. Around two hours later, at about 5:20 p.m., Pawan came out of the café and walked towards his car. As he was about to get into it, three assailants on a motorcycle arrived from the Prayagraj side. Two of the assailants were wearing helmets. The assailants slowed the motorcycle near Pawan's car. The pillion rider fired at Pawan from close range. The bullet hit him in the back. He fell bleeding onto the road as soon as he was shot. The sound of gunfire caused panic among people nearby. The entire incident took place around 500 metres from the police station. After receiving the information, police reached the spot and the injured Pawan was taken to a private hospital in Handia town. As his condition was serious, he was taken to a private hospital in Tagore, from where doctors referred him to SRN. Doctors there declared him dead.

stories.title: Yogi promises 1 lakh government jobs before election:Work will start on 19 September, says 9.5 lakh jobs already given
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath is in Gorakhpur on Wednesday. He said, "We will provide government jobs to 1 lakh people in the next 6 months, before the Assembly election is announced. We are going to start this work on 19 September. s have already been issued for the recruitment of thousands of teachers in government schools." "We have previously provided jobs to 9.5 lakh people. Before 2017, whenever vacancies were announced, the Saifai syndicate would get to work collecting money. No young person got a job. There was bargaining, and people had to go to court. Loot, extortion and lawlessness were part of their twisted mindset." Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath attended 2 programmes in Gorakhpur. First- he inaugurated the Indian Medical Association's charitable blood centre in the morning. He said, "At one time, Uttar Pradesh bore a blot on its image. A dreaded mafia figure led each district. Encephalitis, too, has been eradicated like the mafia and mosquitoes. Today, there is one medical college in every district. There are 75 districts today, but 85 medical colleges." Second- At 4 p.m., Yogi inaugurated the Kalyan Mandapam built by the Gorakhpur Development Authority (GDA). It cost ₹3 crore 9 lakh to construct. The halls on the ground and first floors can accommodate 300 people. It can be booked at affordable rates for weddings and other events. See 2 pictures... Yogi said: Uttar Pradesh is now free of curfews and riots At the inauguration of the Kalyan Mandapam, Yogi said, "Today, Uttar Pradesh is free from curfews and riots. Criminals are either in jail or have departed for the other world. No one can now issue threats openly or commit crimes. Everyone is safe, and there is a guarantee of security for everyone." He said, “Did anyone ever think that Ramgarh Tal would become so beautiful? It is attracting the country and the world. It used to be dirty. In reality, this dirt and disease did not belong to Gorakhpur; they were the result of the dirty mindset of the Samajwadi Party-Congress governments. There was dirt and crime, and no one had access to any facilities. Today, everyone is receiving facilities.”

stories.title: Kanpur govt hospital doctor’s driver treats patients:Prescribes medicines, tells them to buy outside; CMS warns of FIR
stories.summary: A case of endangering patients' lives has come to light at a government hospital in Kanpur. Dr Ramkesh, posted as the emergency medical officer, had gone to court to attend a hearing. His driver then began prescribing medicines to patients. The driver first placed a chair next to the doctor's in the OPD. He then began calling patients in one by one. He asked them about their illnesses and wrote medicines on their prescriptions. When patients asked him whether the medicines would be available at the hospital, the driver said they would have to buy them outside. A video of the incident, which took place on Monday, surfaced at around 2.30 p.m. on Wednesday. Following this, Chief Medical Superintendent (CMS) Dr Piyush Mishra sought an explanation from Dr Ramkesh. He also warned that an FIR would be filed if it happened again. No outsider found during CMS inspection Dr Piyush Mishra, CMS of Kanshiram Hospital, said, "I learnt about the video on Monday evening. The hospital was inspected on Tuesday morning, but no outsider was found there. Dr Ramkesh was also questioned about the matter. The doctor said he had gone to provide court evidence. The person writing the prescriptions at the time was probably his driver, Dev." "Give an explanation or we will file an FIR" CMS Dr Piyush Mishra said that Dr Ramkesh must provide an explanation in the matter. If he fails to do so, an FIR will be registered against him. He warned that if an outsider is again found prescribing medicines to patients in the hospital or OPD in place of a doctor, action will also be taken against the doctor. The government will be informed about the entire matter. People say someone could lose their life Questions are being raised over the hospital administration's conduct after a video emerged showing a driver prescribing medicines to patients at a government hospital instead of a doctor. Several people said that patients rely on doctors for treatment. In such a situation, prescribing medicines to them by an outsider could even cost them their lives. It will become clear only after the investigation and the doctor's response whether the person shown in the video is actually the driver, Dev. Who had allowed him to prescribe medicines to patients? Know about Kanshiram Hospital Kanshi Ram Joint Hospital and Trauma Centre is located along the highway in Kanpur's Ramadevi area. In addition to providing general treatment, it also receives patients involved in accidents. People injured in accidents on the highway are also brought to the hospital. In February 2026, the Director-General of Health inspected the hospital and stressed the need to increase staff and improve healthcare services. During the district magistrate's inspection in May 2025, 64 employees were found absent from duty among the hospital's approximately 200 medical staff.

stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh minister Ashish Patel issued a major statement on Wednesday regarding Sanjay Nishad's meeting with Leader of the Opposition Mata Prasad Pandey. Speaking in Gonda, he said that if someone is in pain, they will certainly seek medicine. He added that he did not have medicine for Sanjay Nishad's pain. Ashish Patel said, "Where can I bring medicine for Sanjay Nishad's pain?" He also said, "If someone is in pain, they should be treated." The previous day, on Tuesday evening, Ashish Patel himself had met minister Sanjay Nishad. Read the three key points from minister Ashish Patel's statement 1. No kind of murder can be justified On the Vinod Sahani murder case, Ashish Patel said, "No kind of murder can be justified." He said, "The government stands firmly with the victim's family." Minister Sanjay Nishad had also staged a protest over the matter and demanded action. 2. There is nothing wrong with standing up against wrongdoing On Sanjay Nishad's protest, Ashish Patel said, "If someone is being wronged and another person stands up against it, that cannot be called wrong." He said, "Action has been taken in the Vinod Sahani murder case. The government stands with the victim. Strong security will be provided." 3. On the AI video, he said, "There should be political decorum" On Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav showing an artificial intelligence (AI) video of Chief Minister Yogi, Ashish Patel said, "He does not support this kind of politics. Irrespective of which side one is on, there is a certain decorum in politics. It should be followed." Minister Sanjay Nishad met Mata Prasad on 14 September Uttar Pradesh cabinet minister Sanjay Nishad met Leader of the Opposition Mata Prasad Pandey on 14 September. Sanjay Nishad visited the Samajwadi Party leader's residence in Lucknow. He presented him with a bouquet. He posted a photograph of the meeting on social media with the caption: "A courtesy meeting. Discussed various issues." Sanjay Nishad had said about the meeting, "When the Samajwadi Party shut its door, we joined the BJP. Now, if the BJP also shuts its door, we will consider other options. We will remain with whoever resolves the issues of the Nishad community." At a meeting with officials in Gonda, Ashish Patel reviewed the 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan' being conducted on the occasion of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's birthday. He directed officials to organise programmes related to the campaign more effectively. A core committee meeting was held at the circuit house from 2 p.m. to 3 p.m. on Wednesday. During the meeting, the minister asked officials to work in coordination with one another. The campaign and other administrative matters related to the district were discussed. Ashish Patel had met Minister Sanjay Nishad a day earlier Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Minister Sanjay Nishad met Technical Education Minister Ashish Patel on Tuesday evening. Ashish Patel himself had gone to Sanjay Nishad's official residence to meet him. Speaking to Dainik Bhaskar about his meeting with Ashish Patel, Minister Nishad had said: "We have decided that the alliance partners will hold a meeting with Uttar Pradesh BJP in-charge Vinod Tawde. We will resolve minor issues, including Nishad reservation, officers not spending the budget on time and the issue of the recruitment of 69,000 teachers. There is no issue over the seats. We should make do with the seats we have received." Minister Nishad had said, "Wherever we contest, the BJP will ask its workers to coordinate with the alliance partners. If there is coordination at the booth level, it will become clear how strong we are. It has been the BJP's tradition for its state in-charges to coordinate with alliance partners and take stock of the ground situation. The seat-sharing arrangement is finalised after that. A meeting with the alliance partners may be held next week." Minister says: Nishad reservation issue needs to be resolved Minister Nishad had said, "We are going to hold a major rally in Allahabad. I have spoken to Ashish Patel to decide the venue. He has held an event there before, so I asked him to suggest a suitable ground. I will hold 10 major rallies across the state. I have also spoken to BJP organisation minister Dharampal." I told him on the issue of Nishad reservation that his party had included it in its agenda. When we joined the BJP, the agreement stated that reservation would be implemented after consideration. Chief Minister Yogi has raised the issue several times in the Assembly. The BJP suffered losses in Uttar Pradesh in 2024. Therefore, the issue should be resolved. The Nishad community was improperly included in the OBC category. Our community is landless, so people should be given land leases. The BSP had taken away the Nishads' livelihoods. Opposition parties create bitterness among the lower strata and foment caste conflict. Sanjay Nishad wrote: Our joint efforts will continue to move forward After the meeting, Sanjay Nishad wrote on X: “Today, I met Ashish Patel, an NDA ally and a Cabinet minister in the Uttar Pradesh government, at his residence in Lucknow. We discussed the government schemes currently being implemented in the state, social representation and issues of public interest. We also discussed improving coordination between the two parties down to the booth level and strengthening the organisation.” “Our shared resolve is to work for the development of the poor, deprived and backward sections. The focus will be on securing a better future for young people, social justice and the rights of every individual. These efforts will continue in the future to build a stronger society, a stronger organisation and a developed Uttar Pradesh.”

stories.title: Ramdev’s company files ₹50-crore defamation suit against Brij Bhushan:Called Patanjali ghee fake; company says brand value hit
stories.summary: Baba Ramdev's company has filed a ₹50 crore defamation case against former BJP MP from Kaiserganj in Gonda, Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh. The Madhya Pradesh High Court heard the case on Tuesday (15 September). Brij Bhushan's lawyer sought more time from the court to file a response. The court has scheduled the next hearing for 18 September. The case relates to Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh calling Patanjali's products, particularly its desi ghee, counterfeit. In 2022, Brij Bhushan had called Patanjali's ghee "counterfeit" at a public event and appealed to people to keep a cow or buffalo at home. His statement had led to a dispute between Baba Ramdev and Brij Bhushan at the time. Patanjali's lawyer says: Statement affected share price Advocate Vikram Malviya appeared in court on behalf of Patanjali Foods. He said the former MP's statement damaged the company's brand image. He also claimed that the company's share price was affected following the controversial statement. This caused the company financial losses. Case reaches High Court from district court Patanjali Foods' registered office is in Vijay Nagar, Indore. Therefore, the claim was first filed in the Indore District Court. The initial hearing in the case took place in the district court. The court issued notices to Brij Bhushan. The case later reached the trial stage. A dispute over the electronic evidence arose during the proceedings. The case reached the High Court over this evidence. In the High Court, the company also submitted documents related to the electronic evidence and cited earlier Supreme Court orders. At the previous hearing, the court had sought a response from Brij Bhushan in the case. During Tuesday's hearing, a lawyer representing the former MP appeared in court and sought time to file a response. Patanjali has already been fined over its ghee It may be recalled that in 2025, the Food Safety Department in Pithoragarh fined Patanjali after its ghee was found not to meet the prescribed standards. In 2020, the Food Safety Department in Pithoragarh had collected a sample of Patanjali's ghee for testing. The sample failed the initial test. The company then sent the sample for a second test. However, the ghee was again found not to meet the prescribed standards. A case was subsequently filed in court. The court then imposed a fine of ₹1 lakh on Patanjali. The feud between Baba Ramdev and Brij Bhushan has been going on for a long time Brij Bhushan's feud with Baba Ramdev dates back a long time. On 17 August last year, Brij Bhushan said in Balrampur, "Ramdev is one-eyed. The person in whose name he is earning his livelihood, Maharishi Patanjali, also has a history rooted here in Gonda." However, he later apologised for the remark. Explaining himself, Brij Bhushan had said, "I made a statement during the Lok Sabha elections. After that, Acharya Balkrishna Bhatt called me and said I was a fool. We also responded in kind, and that is when our dispute began. In Balrampur, I was explaining the history of Gonda, Balrampur and the Devipatan division." During this, Maharishi Patanjali was mentioned. I remembered that when Baba Ramdev had set out on his Swadeshi Yatra, he had mentioned the birthplace of Maharishi Patanjali in Gonda and promised to develop it. He had made this promise to the public. In that context, I remembered Baba Ramdev. A few words came out of my mouth. I later realised that I should not have said that. This happened about eight months ago. Brij Bhushan saw the pimples on a student's face, held his hand and stopped him. He asked him why he had so many pimples on his face. "This is fake oil that is coming out, understand? This is Ramdev's ghee coming out." People began laughing as soon as they heard Brij Bhushan make this statement from the stage. He had earlier also commented on fake ghee On 24 November 2022, while he was a Member of Parliament, Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh said at a religious discourse tent in Barabanki, “If there is no disease in the body, no one is richer than that person. A weak person's child is born weak. A healthy person's child is born healthy. To remain healthy, it is essential to maintain cleanliness at home and have milk and ghee. Milk is easily available in villages. I, too, used to go out grazing buffaloes. Only by keeping buffaloes and cows will you get pure milk and ghee. Otherwise, you will have to eat Ramdev's counterfeit ghee.”

stories.title: Man runs car over girlfriend in Lucknow:Drives off with her clinging onto bonnet; caught with another woman
stories.summary: A hit-and-run case has emerged from Lucknow, where a car driver hit a girl, causing her to get dragged onto the bonnet. Despite her screaming, the accused refused to stop the car. After driving forward for 20 to 25 meters, he accelerated, causing the girl to fall onto the road before running over her and fleeing the scene. The incident took place on Wednesday near Janeshwar Mishra Park in Gomti Nagar Extension, and video footage of the event has surfaced. Fortunately, the girl narrowly survived; she sustained injuries and is currently receiving medical treatment at a hospital. The injured girl has been identified as Anamika, and the accused as Shahnawaz, both residents of Lucknow. Anamika is reported to be Shahnawaz's girlfriend. According to the police, Anamika caught Shahnawaz with a new girlfriend, which led to an argument between them. When Shahnawaz attempted to drive away, Anamika stood in front of the car to block him, after which Shahnawaz tried to kill her. Anamika alleges that Shahnawaz had trapped her by concealing his identity under the fake name Yash Thakur. Police have arrested Shahnawaz and registered a case against him for attempted murder. It is being reported that Shahnawaz had been in an affair with Anamika for a year. On Wednesday, he came to drink tea near Janeshwar Park in a Verna car accompanied by another girl. As soon as Anamika found out, she arrived at the spot. Upon seeing Shahnawaz with another girl, an argument broke out between them. During this altercation, Anamika discovered that the accused's real name was Shahnawaz, not Yash. Infuriated by this revelation, she started shouting. Seeing the situation escalate, the girl who had come with Shahnawaz left the scene. After this, Shahnawaz got into his car and tried to flee. Anamika stood in front of the car to block him, whereupon Shahnawaz drove forward, hit her, and sped away. An eyewitness recalled: "We saw a car come to a stop first. A short while later, two people arrived there on a scooter. There were two people inside the car as well. As soon as the scooter stopped, the car began moving slowly. The woman riding the scooter tried to stop the car, so the driver pulled over a short distance away." "When people approached to talk to him, he suddenly sped off in the car. The girl sustained severe injuries in the incident, including a broken arm. She was crying out in pain and pleading while weeping, 'God, save me. I am going to die.' The incident occurred around 6:00 AM while I was on my way to serve tea to customers."

stories.title: ‘If I don’t kill them, they will kill me’:Muzaffarnagar security guard’s son demands encounter of accused, threatens revenge
stories.summary: Just as my father was shot dead, the police should also kill his killers in an encounter. If that does not happen, I will be forced to take revenge. My family has been destroyed. If I do not kill them, they will kill me. Saying this, Sagar, the son of security guard Subhash Baliyan, broke down in tears. Subhash was shot dead at around 10.30am on 15 September while he was cycling to work. The attackers stopped him and shot him in the chest. The incident took place in Kinoni village, under Shahpur police station, around 45 km from the district headquarters. Subhash’s elder son, Aakash, is in jail on charges of eloping with a girl from the village. The family suspects that Subhash was killed because of the enmity arising from the relationship. A village council meeting was held over the matter two days earlier, where the girl gave a statement in favour of Aakash before being sent to Nari Niketan. Read what younger son Sagar said Sagar said his father had been travelling to work on his bicycle when he was shot. “The accused had been calling my father and me to their house. They had planned to kill both of us. By chance, we did not go. They wanted to create an impression that we had attacked their house and that they had killed us in retaliation. “The accused belong to an influential family in the village and have licensed guns. My brother Aakash is in jail even though he has not committed any offence and the girl has given a statement in his favour. The police have been negligent. They took one-sided action and sent my brother to jail without considering the girl’s statement. He said- “I want security for myself and my family. Just as they shot my father, the police should shoot them. I want support from the police administration and want the accused to be killed in an encounter. Otherwise, the matter will escalate further and I will have to take revenge. “If the police administration takes no action and I am not given security, I will avenge my father’s death myself. My home has been destroyed. My brother is in jail, my father is dead and my mother is ill. I am the only one left. If I do not kill them, they will kill me. If I had gone with my father, they would have killed me that day.” Subhash worked as a security guard at a private factory Subhash, 50, was a resident of Kinoni village in the Shahpur police station area. He worked as a security guard at a private factory near Budhana Mod. His family comprises his wife, Mamta alias Pinky, and two sons, Sagar, 26, and Aakash, 25. Subhash owned seven bighas of land, which the family cultivated. Satender’s family also lived in the village. He has a son, Hariom alias Shubham, 25, and a 22-year-old daughter. Satender owned 18 bighas of land, which the family cultivated. Subhash’s son Aakash was in a relationship with Satender’s daughter. Although the two belonged to the same caste, their families were opposed to the marriage. Aakash eloped with the girl a month ago Around a month ago, Aakash left home with the girl. Her family filed a case against him. Police traced the couple and sent Aakash to jail, while the girl was sent to Nari Niketan in Meerut. The dispute between the two families intensified after this. A village council meeting was held two days ago, during which the girl gave a statement in favour of Aakash. She was subsequently sent back to Nari Niketan. Girl’s father and brother accused of murder On the morning of 15 September, Subhash left home for work. Some people surrounded him and shot him in the chest. His family has accused the girl’s brother, Hariom, and her father, Satender, of the murder. Police have found that the firing was carried out with a .312-bore country-made pistol. Affair-related rivalry angle being investigated SSP Sanjay Kumar Verma said an angle of rivalry arising from the relationship had emerged. He said police were investigating the case from all angles. Police are examining CCTV footage from cameras installed around the crime scene and other evidence to identify the attackers. The SSP said efforts were being made to arrest the accused soon.

stories.title: Crorepati businessman’s daughter-in-law reaches court:Hides her face with dupatta, tells cops to stop people from taking photos
stories.summary: Three accused, including daughter-in-law Shalu, were produced before Chief Judicial Magistrate Pradeep Kumar Shukla’s court in the murder case of millionaire pharmaceutical businessman Vineet Minocha in Kanpur. Shalu reached the court at 10.30 am on Wednesday. She kept her face covered with her dupatta and appeared to avoid the cameras. She told police personnel, “Stop them.” Police have sought 24-hour custody of all three accused. The application is being heard. Meanwhile, police have found several vital clues in the businessman’s murder. Call detail records showed that after entering the society on the night of the murder, 5 September, accused Vishal and Rajkishore walked around the premises while speaking to each other over the phone. Police suspect that they discussed the murder plan and how to enter the flat during this time. See 2 pictures- Initial plan was for only one accused to enter Police questioning revealed that the initial plan was for one accused to enter the flat while the other kept watch outside. However, after seeing Vineet’s strong build, both decided to enter together. Police examined the call detail records of Vishal, Shalu and Subrat’s mobile numbers and questioned the accused in jail. This helped establish links in the alleged murder conspiracy and track the accused’s activities before the crime. Police have also taken custody of around four hours of video footage from the couples’ kitty party held at Cosmozin Lounge in Tilak Nagar. During the investigation, they also obtained from the registry office the will document prepared by Vineet’s wife, Punita Minocha, in June 2022. Vishal bought a new SIM card two days before the murder Police Commissioner Raghubir Lal said Vishal bought a new SIM card on 3 September, two days before the murder. He used an Aadhaar card in the name of Shivam as identification to purchase it. After obtaining the new number, Vishal spoke to Shalu seven times and Subrat six times by phone between 3 and 6 September. The call records also showed that Vishal spoke to Rajkishore 21 times between 1 May and 6 September. After the murder, Vishal deactivated the new SIM at 7.57 am on 6 September. Both accused wandered around the apartment for 48 minutes According to police, Vishal and Subrat arrived with a garland at 8.46 pm on 5 September at Shalu’s request. At 9.38 pm, accused Vishal and Rajkishore entered the apartment. After handing the items to Shalu at around 9.50 pm, they wandered around the premises. During this time, Vishal and Rajkishore spoke to each other three times by mobile phone. At 10.38 pm, the two entered Vineet’s flat using a duplicate key. Around 20 minutes later, at 10.58 pm, Vineet arrived home. He heard a noise coming from Shalu’s room. When he reached the room, he found both accused hiding there. A struggle then broke out between them. According to police, CCTV footage showed both accused leaving the flat at 11.28 pm. Called a friend after the murder According to police, Vishal deactivated the new SIM after the crime. He then booked an Uber cab using the new number. At 11.38 pm, he called his friend Naitik Verma, alias Kishan, a resident of Mirpur Cantonment. The two spoke for some time. Police are now investigating this call and Vishal’s activities after the crime. Punita’s will also under investigation During the investigation, police obtained from the registry office the will document prepared by Vineet’s wife, Punita Minocha, in June 2022. They are examining it. It is not yet clear in whose name the property was bequeathed in the will. Police are also examining the document as part of their investigation into the possible motive behind the murder. 24-hour remand sought for Shalu and Vishal DCP West SM Qasim Abidi said police had sought 24 hours of custody of daughter-in-law Shalu and contract killer Vishal to question them and cross-examine his son Subrat. On Tuesday, Kalyanpur Inspector Keshav Kumar Tiwari filed a petition in court seeking their remand. The hearing will take place on Wednesday. Meanwhile, Shalu’s bail petition was heard in the district judge’s court on Tuesday. Her lawyer did not press the bail petition for the time being.

stories.title: UP panchayat assistants’ salary hiked 50%:No job cuts, cashless treatment; women to get maternity leave
stories.summary: The Yogi government has taken a major decision regarding the Panchayat Assistants protesting in Lucknow. Their honorarium has been increased by ₹3,000. Instead of ₹6,000, they will now receive ₹9,000. In other words, the government has hiked their honorarium by 50 per cent. There are 57,000 Panchayat Assistants in the state. Panchayati Raj Minister Rajbhar announced the increase in honorarium during a press conference in Lucknow on Wednesday. He stated, "This decision was taken after discussions with CM Yogi." Minister Rajbhar stated: "Now, no Village Head (Gram Pradhan) or Panchayat Secretary can arbitrarily remove a Panchayat Assistant from their post. Before removing a Panchayat Assistant, a committee constituted under the leadership of the DM will conduct an investigation. The decision to terminate services will be taken only after the inquiry." "Panchayat Assistants will receive the benefit of cashless facilities for medical treatment. Female Panchayat Assistants will also get maternity leave." “Now, the honorarium amount will be transferred directly into the Panchayat Assistant's bank account. Previously, the honorarium was deposited into the Village Head's account and withdrawn only after joint signatures from the Secretary and Village Head.” "Cases registered against Panchayat Assistants during the protests will be withdrawn. Those Panchayat Assistants who were removed following administrative action during this period will be reinstated." Panchayat Assistants end protest Panchayat Assistants had been protesting at Eco Garden in Lucknow since September 7. As soon as they learned about the government's decision, the Panchayat Assistants expressed joy, called off the demonstration, and returned to their homes. Five demands of Panchayat Assistants; nearly four fulfilled 1. Increase honorarium to ₹20,000–₹25,000: The government increased the honorarium by ₹3,000. 2. Make Panchayat Assistants permanent instead of contractual: The government has not accepted this demand yet. 3. Transfer the honorarium directly into bank accounts: The government accepted this demand. 4. Conduct a proper investigation before termination: Accepted. A Panchayat Assistant will only be removed after an inquiry led by the DM. 5. Withdraw cases registered during protests: The government accepted this demand as well. Honorarium of Anganwadi Workers Increased Up to ₹4 Thousand Honorarium of Outsourced Employees Increased Up to ₹11,000 Two Days Ago, Rajbhar Said: "Get it Out of Your Mind, You Won't Get ₹25,000" On September 14, the protesting Panchayat Assistants met Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar. At that time, he had said: "Considering budget constraints, providing an honorarium of ₹12,000 or ₹15,000 is not possible. Get it out of your mind that you will get ₹20,000 to ₹25,000 rupees. That will absolutely not happen." He added: "I have seen in villages that people go to Common Service Centers (CSCs) to fill out online forms. This is your job. People probably go outside because you don't work. You weren't appointed just to draw a salary. If everyone worked properly, this could have been considered. People are drawing honorariums while sitting idle. Most of those recruited are family members of Village Heads or influential people." Leaders who extended support to the Panchayat Assistants On the Panchayat Assistants' protest, BSP chief Mayawati said that the government should consider their demands. Pallavi Patel of Apna Dal (Kamerawadi) and MP Chandrashekhar also visited the protest site to show their support. Chandrashekhar stated, "Until their demands are met, our brothers will not fill anyone's demands." Finally, read 2 key points from Rajbhar's press conference: 1. "Even if they form an alliance, they can't match a single NDA party" Minister Rajbhar said: "It is like the saying, 'Neither will nine maunds of oil be bought, nor will Radha dance' (a local idiom meaning a condition that will never be met). Owaisi Ji says he will become the Chief Minister, so will they agree? Will anyone agree? How will an alliance be formed? Congress says it wants 200 seats. Akhilesh Yadav says he won't contest fewer than 300 seats. Everyone is trying, but the effort is futile." "BJP has a massive support base today. In UP, there are four parties in the NDA alongside the BJP. All four parties have the power to pull votes in the state. We are watching all these alliances being formed. Let them unite—I believe they cannot even compete with a single partner of the NDA alliance." 2. "Akhilesh should declare a Muslim as the Chief Minister" Rajbhar said: "Akhilesh Yadav is worried about Muslim brothers, and Muslim brothers are worried about Akhilesh Yadav. There is no harmony between the two. Before UCC, Akhilesh Yadav should declare that if his government is formed, he will make a Muslim the Chief Minister." He added: "Akhilesh Yadav is very sympathetic toward Muslims. Muslims have voted four times to make Yadav Ji the Chief Minister. Now it is his duty to give them a chance too, so they don't get the opportunity to say that people form governments by taking their votes. Akhilesh Yadav gets the majority of Muslim votes; we in the NDA alliance get a bit less. Therefore, he should make this declaration."

stories.title: Chat between cricketer Shami’s brother and woman surfaces:Alleges sexual exploitation in Lucknow; case transferred to Ghaziabad
stories.summary: The case registered in Lucknow against Mohammad Kaif, brother of Indian cricketer Mohammad Shami, has now been transferred to Ghaziabad. The woman who filed the complaint reached Ashiyana police station on Wednesday. After being given a copy of the FIR, she was informed that the case had been transferred. The woman has accused Kaif of having sexual relations with her on the pretext of marriage and later threatening to kill her. During its initial investigation, Lucknow Police found that the location of the alleged incident mentioned in the complaint fell under the jurisdiction of Indirapuram police station. The case was therefore transferred to the relevant police station, and Ghaziabad Police will now investigate the matter. Meanwhile, another chat between the woman and the accused Mohammad Kaif has surfaced. Read what the chat says... Some screenshots of the conversation between Kaif and the woman have surfaced. They show the conversation between the two. Case transferred to Ghaziabad Ashiyana Inspector Gajendra Rai said the woman had been called to the police station for two consecutive days to record her statement, but she did not appear. Police then examined the sequence of events and locations mentioned in her complaint and found that the place where the alleged incident took place fell under the jurisdiction of Indirapuram police station. The case was subsequently transferred there. Deputy Commissioner of Police (Central) Vikrant Veer said the woman's complaint did not clearly specify the location of the incident. A notice was therefore being issued to her and preparations were under way to record her statement. During the investigation, it emerged that the incident had taken place in Indirapuram, Ghaziabad, following which the case was transferred there. Now, read the story of how the two met... The woman told Dainik Bhaskar, "I was introduced to Mohammed Kaif on Instagram in 2020. At that time, Mohammed Kaif was not even playing domestic cricket. In August 2023, he expressed his desire to marry me. When I told him that I was divorced, he said he had no objection to my past." According to the woman, the two first met in Ghaziabad on 11 September 2023 and continued meeting afterwards. While playing in Delhi, Kaif called her to hotels several times. She claims that she stayed with him in Delhi for several days. A few months later, when the woman reminded Kaif about his promise to marry her, he called her to Kolkata. She alleges that he had sexual relations with her at a hotel there after promising to marry her. Called her to Lucknow's Hyatt hotel, promised marriage after IPL auction The woman alleged that Kaif had promised to marry her after the IPL auction and had also sworn on the Quran that he would do so. According to her, Bengal's Ranji team came to Lucknow on 11 October 2024, with Mohammad Kaif travelling with the team. He called her to the Hyatt hotel in Gomti Nagar, where she alleges that he had sexual relations with her. The woman said, "Mohammad Kaif and his elder brother are threatening me today. If I am standing on the streets and raising my voice today, it is because I was wronged. I want to tell the police to register my complaint. If the investigation finds me guilty, I should also be punished." She said that at the time, she worked as cabin crew for an airline company in Delhi. She alleged that Kaif asked her to quit her job and promised to marry her. The woman claims that she resigned after trusting Kaif's promise. Even after that, they did not marry. She had hoped to marry him after the IPL auction in December 2025, but this did not happen. When she pressured Kaif to marry her in January 2026, she alleges that he began distancing himself and stopped speaking to her. Called her to Kolkata after allegations were made on a podcast The woman said she spoke to Mohammad Kaif's elder brother, Mohammad Haseeb, about marrying Kaif. He initially told her that he would speak to Kaif and get back to her. Later, she alleges, Haseeb began calling her a honey trapper. According to the woman, after being harassed continuously, she recounted her ordeal on a sports channel's podcast on 29 April. Ten days later, on 9 May, Mohammad Kaif called her and asked her to have the podcast removed. He promised to speak to his family and marry her, and called her to Kolkata again. She alleges that there, after once again promising to marry her, he had sexual relations with her several times. Called to Amroha and threatened with claims of high-level connections According to the woman, Mohammad Kaif had sexual relations with her on 18 May. The next day, on 19 May, she was called to a man's house in Amroha to discuss marriage. Kaif's elder brother, his mother and others were present there. The woman alleges that she was threatened during the conversation. His elder brother, Haseeb, allegedly said they had connections at the highest levels and that she could not harm them in any way. She said that on 30 May, she informed Kaif about the entire incident in Amroha. According to her, Kaif did not help her and also refused to marry her. She said these events left her deeply distressed. FIR registered at Ashiyana police station The woman submitted written complaints at Lucknow's Ashiyana police station on 31 August and Vibhuti Khand police station on 2 September. When no case was registered, she went to the DCP East's office on 5 September and submitted a complaint seeking registration of an FIR against Mohammad Kaif and legal action. Finally, on 13 September, based on her complaint, a case was registered at Ashiyana police station against Mohammad Kaif under Section 69 of the BNS for allegedly having sexual relations on the false promise of marriage, and under Section 351 for allegedly threatening to kill her and cause harm. However, after the investigation found that the alleged incident took place within the jurisdiction of Indirapuram police station in Ghaziabad, the case was transferred there. Indirapuram Police will now investigate the matter based on the woman's statement and the available evidence.

stories.title: Man kills wife, tells cops ‘Salaam sahab’ when they arrive:Beheads her while she was sleeping; couple had love marriage
stories.summary: A husband allegedly killed his wife in Hardoi while she was sleeping, severing her head with a knife. After the murder, he called his sister and told her, “I have killed my wife.” His sister informed the police. When officers arrived, the accused was sitting quietly in the room. He showed no apparent concern and greeted the police by saying, “Salaam, sir.” The woman’s body was lying beside him, with her head severed from her torso. Blood was spread across the room. The incident took place around 3am on Wednesday in the City Kotwali area. According to the police, the accused, Parvez, 34, had a love marriage 12 years ago with Nagma, 30, who was related to him as his niece. The couple had no children. Parvez suspected that Nagma was having an affair with a motorcycle mechanic named Nazim. The couple had been arguing over the issue frequently for the past eight months. See two pictures related to the crime- Couple lived in rented house after selling share in ancestral property Parvez and Nagma lived in the Islamnagar Tiliya neighbourhood. He had earlier lived in his ancestral house, which was jointly owned by his mother Shahnaz, his deceased brother Raji’s wife Allu, and Parvez. After his marriage, Parvez faced difficulties living there and sold his share to his sister Rubina for ₹1.5 lakh. He then moved into a rented house. His sister Jubina lived in the adjoining room with her husband, Gulfam. On Tuesday night, Nagma was sleeping on a cot when Parvez allegedly killed her. The door was closed and a high-speed fan was running, so no one in the adjoining room realised what had happened. At around 3.30am on Wednesday, Parvez called Jubina and informed her about the incident. Sister says accused had been threatening Nagma Shabbo, Nagma’s sister, reached the scene after being informed of the murder. She said Parvez had been beating Nagma for the past week and threatening to slit her throat. She said, “He slit her throat and killed her today. I do not know why the murder took place because we have come from far away. Her sister and brother-in-law were sleeping in the adjoining room; they would know what happened.”

stories.title: 'I’ll make you an IAS officer through CM quota':SP leader calls bank employee 'a complete woman' and praises her looks; FIR registered
stories.summary: An SP leader sent romantic messages to a woman bank employee in Mathura. After meeting her during a morning walk, the SP leader began messaging her frequently. He started praising her qualifications and even offered to have her appointed as an IAS officer through the chief minister's quota if the party formed the government. The woman bank employee felt uncomfortable with the chats sent to her on WhatsApp. She complained to the police about the entire matter. An FIR was subsequently registered on Tuesday. After the SP leader's chats went viral, the party also distanced itself from him. He has been removed as the state general secretary of the Minority Sabha on charges of engaging in anti-party activities. Here is the full story in detail The woman is a customer service associate at a bank branch in Mathura. Her husband is an officer with the Forest Department in Mathura. The Samajwadi Party leader, Dr Rajan Rizvi, against whom she has made the allegations, holds a PhD. He has been active in the Samajwadi Party since its inception. The party had assigned him the responsibility of state general secretary of its Minority Assembly. His residence is located right next to the Forest Department office. She would often meet the woman bank employee while out walking in the morning. In the FIR registered at the City Kotwali police station, the woman wrote that Dr Rajan Rizvi was gathering her personal information. He also obtained the mobile number of the woman bank employee and sent her objectionable and unsolicited messages. The messages were later deleted, but before that, the woman bank employee took screenshots. Troubled by Rajan Rizvi's behaviour, the woman bank employee blocked his number. The woman alleges that after this, Rajan Rizvi began gathering information about her husband, who works in the Forest Department, as well as other personal information. Read exactly what was written on WhatsApp... In a WhatsApp chat sent to the woman bank employee, Dr Rajan Rizvi wrote- Madam, namaste. I apologise if my words hurt you. However, I did not say anything to you that was against propriety. I respect you greatly. You are a woman with an extra aura. Along with being beautiful, you have a very good nature. You are an expert at your work-in other words, you are a complete woman. I do not think this job suits someone with your personality. If I move forward in politics in the future and the Samajwadi Party forms the government, I will try to get you made an IAS officer through the Chief Minister's quota on a deputation basis. I hope you will have positive vibes towards me in your heart. I hope you will give me your blessings. Dr Rajan Rizvi, Mathura. Hindu activists allege love jihad After the complaint filed by the female bank employee and the WhatsApp chat went viral, an FIR was registered against Dr Rajan Rizvi at the City Kotwali under Section 67 of the Information Technology Act. The Hindu organisation expressed its gratitude to the administration after an FIR was registered against Dr Rajan Rizvi, state general secretary of the Samajwadi Party Minority Assembly, for harassing the woman. Former state vice-president of the Akhil Bharat Hindu Mahasabha, Pandit Sanjay Haryana, said that a Hindu woman was being harassed by Dr Rajan Rizvi, a Samajwadi Party leader from a particular community, who was sending her WhatsApp messages. He alleged that an attempt was being made to make her a victim of love jihad. This had sparked outrage in society. Met the CO, received assurance of action Ram Gopal Sharma, national president of the Parshuram Shobha Yatra Committee, and Pandit Sanjay Haryana held a meeting and expressed their displeasure over the entire matter. The Hindutva organisation met City CO Ashna Chaudhary along with the woman and her husband. City CO Ashna Chaudhary assured them that action would be taken after an investigation. Attempts were made to contact SP leader Dr Rajan Rizvi for information about the matter, but he could not be reached.

stories.title: Cop saves youth drowning in canal:Python swallows peacock in Lakhimpur; rain alert in 56 districts
stories.summary: Rivers are in spate across Uttar Pradesh following rainfall, with flood-like conditions reported in 26 districts. Around 400,000 people have been affected. In Gonda, the Saryu river has risen again, submerging thousands of bighas of farmland. Around 14,000 people from 18 villages are surrounded by floodwater. Meanwhile, in Bulandshahr, a constable and a diver rescued a young man who was drowning in a canal. The man reportedly jumped into the canal himself. After seeing him drowning, the constable also jumped in and pulled him out. Python swallows peacock in Lakhimpur Kheri In Lakhimpur Kheri, a python swallowed a peacock in a field. In Budaun, the Ganga river has risen again, with water flowing over a bridge. Several areas are now facing the threat of flooding. See photos of flood and rain - Rain alert issued for 56 districts The Meteorological Department has issued a rain alert for 56 districts on Wednesday. Most cities have been sunny since morning. Rain was recorded in 25 cities on Tuesday. Uttar Pradesh has received 667.5 mm of rainfall since 1 June, which is 4% below the normal 692 mm. Lucknow meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said- The monsoon is still active in Uttar Pradesh. A system has formed over the Bay of Bengal. As a result, rainfall is likely to continue in different parts of the state over the next few days. Eastern UP is more likely to receive rain.

stories.title: Hockey player found hanging from dog leash:Gonda youth dies by suicide after argument with friend; girlfriend’s WhatsApp call came after death
stories.summary: A 19-year-old state-level hockey player died by suicide by hanging in Gonda on Tuesday. Vivek Kumar Gupta's body was found hanging from a dog collar. His brother said he may have taken the step after an argument with a girl. At the time of his death, Vivek was holding a mobile phone, on which a WhatsApp call from a girl was coming in. Police sent the body for post-mortem. The incident took place in the Nagar Kotwali police station area. See 2 photos- Now know the full case Vivek Kumar Gupta, 19, who lived on Bahraich Road, ran a cosmetics shop and had also played hockey at state level. According to his family, Vivek spent the day at his shop on Tuesday. He returned home in the evening for dinner and went back to the shop after some time. After returning from the shop, he went to his room. Body found hanging from dog collar At around 6pm, family members entered the room and found Vivek hanging from a dog collar. They informed the police, following which personnel from Nagar Kotwali and Mishrauliya outpost reached the spot with a forensic team. According to the family, they checked Vivek's mobile phone after the incident and found that a girl was calling him on WhatsApp. His elder brother, Vinay Gupta, said there were no problems related to the family or business. Vivek used to speak to a girl, and the family suspects that he took the step following an argument with her. However, the exact cause of death will be clear only after the police investigation is completed. Last played at state-level tournament in 2024 Vivek had been interested in sports from an early age. He started playing hockey at the age of 10. After around eight years of practice, he began participating in district, divisional and state-level competitions from 2018. In 2024, Vivek played his last match in a state-level hockey tournament organised to mark the birth anniversary of Major Dhyan Chand. He missed out on a top-three finish by just one point. For the past two years, he had been playing in district- and divisional-level competitions. Vivek's team had won several district-level competitions, and he had also won several prizes at divisional level. Police seize mobile phone for investigation The family handed Vivek's mobile phone over to the police. Nagar Kotwal Bindeshwari Mani Tripathi said the phone had been taken into custody and was being examined. The family has raised the possibility that Vivek had an argument with a girl, and police are also trying to trace her. The family also said that around a year ago, Vivek's stepbrother had died under suspicious circumstances in the same house.

stories.title: 4 complaints filed against AISA national president:Neha Bora made objectionable remarks against CM in Gorakhpur; faces social media backlash
stories.summary: AISA national president Neha Bora allegedly made objectionable remarks against CM Yogi Adityanath at an event held on Monday in Gorakhpur. The matter has now escalated, with three separate complaints filed at Cantt police station and a written complaint submitted at Pipiganj police station on Tuesday. Neha Bora has also faced sharp criticism on social media. Several organisations are preparing to submit further complaints on Wednesday. The complainants have demanded action against both Neha Bora and the organisers of the event. Police are investigating the matter based on videos circulated on social media and the complaints received. OBC Party chief submits complaint at Cantt police station On Tuesday, Kali Shankar Yaduvanshi, national president of the OBC Party (One Bharat Citizen Party), reached Cantt police station with party workers and submitted a complaint demanding registration of a case. He alleged that objectionable remarks were made against the Chief Minister at the programme. He also alleged that indecent comments were made about Gorakhpur's historic land. Yaduvanshi warned of a protest if no action was taken. Vishwa Hindu Mahasangh delegation also files complaint In the same matter, a delegation led by Janardan Mishra J.D., district president of the Vishwa Hindu Mahasangh, submitted a complaint to the Cantt police station in-charge. Lawyers also submitted a complaint to the CO Cantt. The organisation described the speech as indecent and inflammatory and demanded that the available video be examined and appropriate action taken. Meanwhile, Adarsh Singh, president of the BJP Yuva Morcha's Pipiganj Mandal, submitted a complaint at Pipiganj police station.

stories.title: Lawrence Bishnoi gang’s arms network busted:5 smugglers held in Gorakhpur, sold pistols and revolvers through Instagram
stories.summary: The Gorakhpur STF and Crime Branch have busted an arms network allegedly linked to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang operating in the district. Five suspected gang members were arrested near Vindhyavasini Park on Monday night. Police recovered four .32-bore pistols, four magazines, one .32-bore revolver and five live cartridges from their possession. According to police, questioning revealed that the accused were in contact with people linked to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang and had been procuring pistols from them for supply across eastern Uttar Pradesh. The accused allegedly sold firearms through Instagram. A case was registered under the Arms Act at Cantt police station, and the five were produced before a court on Tuesday afternoon, which sent them to jail. The arrested accused have been identified as Shreyansh Yadav alias Bablu, a resident of Badhra Jagdishpur in Vijayeepur, Gopalganj, Bihar, currently living in Harahwa Phatak; Ajit Yadav, a resident of the Kali Temple area in Ward No. 5 of Deoria Kotwali; Abhishek Gaur alias Bheli, a resident of Dharamshala Bazaar in Gorakhnath; Rahul Gupta, a resident of Jatepur South; and Abhishek Prajapati alias Abhi, a resident of Madhopur in Tiwari­pur. The joint team of the Special Task Force and Anti-Theft Unit involved in the arrests included Inspector Satya Prakash Singh, Sunil Rai, Sub-Inspector Vinayak Singh and Yashwant Singh, along with 22 police personnel. Five arrested near Vindhyavasini Park at 10:20pm The STF and Crime Branch teams arrested all five at around 10:20 pm on Monday near the gate of Vindhyavasini Park, on the road from Paidleganj towards Mohaddipur intersection. During questioning, the accused allegedly told police that they had purchased illegal pistols from Barwani in Madhya Pradesh and Sonipat in Haryana and sold them in various districts of eastern Uttar Pradesh. According to sources, each pistol was sold for ₹30,000 to ₹40,000. Information has emerged that between 100 and 150 pistols were sold in Gorakhpur and adjoining districts over the past three years. Police are examining the accused's mobile phones and transaction details to verify this claim. The STF investigation also found that PAC Constable Suraj Yadav, a resident of the Khajani area, and his associate Pramod had allegedly bought a pistol from the gang for ₹1.5 lakh to have a murder carried out. Shashank Pandey allegedly linked accused to Bishnoi gang The STF claims that Shashank Pandey, a Bihar resident living in a rented room in Singhadia, had connected the accused with the Lawrence Bishnoi gang. The weapons procurement and supply network allegedly expanded after this. The STF is searching for Shashank and 10 other people. The investigation has also revealed that the network extended beyond Uttar Pradesh to Haryana, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra. Police are now working to establish the entire chain, from the source of the weapons to the buyers. Firearms allegedly sold through Instagram The STF investigation found that the gang had allegedly sold around 150 illegal pistols in various districts of Purvanchal through Instagram. People connected to its local network were brought into the operation to arrange the sale of the weapons. The STF and Anti-Theft Unit are also gathering information about other people linked to the network. Five accused already face criminal cases Shreyansh Yadav alias Bablu, a resident of Jagdishpur Badhra in Bihar's Gopalganj, was among those arrested in the joint STF and Anti-Theft Unit operation. He lived in a rented room in the Gorakhnath area. Two cases involving theft and criminal breach of trust had already been registered against him at Cantt and Gularia police stations. Five cases, including charges related to attempted murder, the SC/ST Act and the Arms Act, have been registered against the second accused, Ajit Yadav of Bhatwalia in the Deoria Kotwali police station area. The third accused, Abhishek Gaur alias Bheli, a resident of Dharamshala in Gorakhnath, has a case of assault registered against him from 2024. The fourth accused, Abhishek Prajapati alias Abhi, a resident of Madhopur in the Tiwari­pur police station area, has a case registered against him under the Arms Act. Rahul Gupta of Jatepur South in Dharamshala Bazaar is also among those arrested. No case was found against him at any police station.

stories.title: 'Murder plot was hatched at farmhouse':MP Chandrashekhar says, 'Death comes one day, we cannot live in fear'; urges govt to investigate
stories.summary: Bhim Army chief and Nagina MP Chandrashekhar has claimed that a conspiracy to assassinate him was allegedly hatched at a farmhouse. He said, “The information I have is not wrong. I demand that the government order an investigation into the entire matter. The truth will come out.” However, he did not name anyone allegedly involved in the plot. Late on Tuesday night, Chandrashekhar posted a video on X and said- Death will come one day; one cannot live in fear of death. If my death has been written at your hands, it will happen too. But if you fail in your plans and my people give me strength, courage and their support, then remember that goons like you will have to flee Uttar Pradesh. Chandrashekhar’s 3 key points 1- Wherever there was injustice and oppression, we raised our voice Chandrashekhar said his struggle would continue as long as he lived. He referred to the UGC issue, ongoing protests over reservation, and several cases, including those involving Ram Lakhan Maurya, Vinod Sahni, the Lalita murder case and the mosque case in Saharanpur. He said the Azad Samaj Party had continued to raise the voice of weaker sections in the state and had gone wherever people faced injustice and oppression. Chandrashekhar alleged that when his opponents were unable to stop him politically, they held a meeting at a farmhouse two days ago to plan his murder. He said he was making the claim with a sense of responsibility and was not giving false information. 2- Criminals are so emboldened that they are throwing stones He said that despite being under security, criminals were allegedly carrying out such acts of violence. He claimed that people had confronted his supporters, thrown stones and attempted to set vehicles on fire using bottles containing substances resembling petrol or diesel. Chandrashekhar questioned what Dalits, backward classes and Muslims must be facing in the state if an elected MP who received more than 5.25 lakh votes could be treated in such a manner in broad daylight. 3- ‘Some people admitted that they were looking for me’ Chandrashekhar also questioned the role of the police and said he could not accept that justice was being delivered when people associated with his side were involved in accidents or cases of murder and rape. He claimed that some people had admitted they were looking for him and had arrived carrying inflammable substances while allegedly attempting to set a vehicle on fire. He said this was why he believed the information about a murder conspiracy being discussed at a farmhouse was not incorrect. Chandrashekhar and former girlfriend Rohini’s supporters clashed three days ago Three days ago, supporters of Chandrashekhar and his former girlfriend, Rohini Ghawari, clashed in Barabanki. Chandrashekhar was travelling from Lucknow to Gonda with around 1,000 workers to meet the family of Vinod Sahani, who was killed in a murder case. After receiving information about his arrival, the police went on alert. More than 100 personnel barricaded the area and stopped Chandrashekhar. Meanwhile, hundreds of Rohini Ghawari’s supporters reached the spot and raised slogans including “Down with Chandrashekhar Ravan” and “Justice for Rohini Ghawari”. An argument then broke out between the two groups. The situation soon escalated into pushing and shoving. Police removed Rohini’s supporters and took Chandrashekhar towards the Police Inspection Building. The MP then sat on the road. After around 20–25 minutes, he returned to Lucknow with his workers.

stories.title: Sanjay Nishad meets minister Ashish Patel in Lucknow:Says, ‘Will work together for every section’; met LoP Mata Prasad a day earlier
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Minister Sanjay Nishad met Technical Education Minister Ashish Patel on Tuesday evening, September 15. Patel personally visited Nishad’s official residence for the meeting. A day earlier, Nishad had met Leader of the Opposition Mata Prasad on Monday evening. Allies may press BJP over seat-sharing Political analysts believe that with the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections approaching, NDA allies have started putting pressure on the BJP over seat-sharing arrangements. Ashish Patel is the husband of Apna Dal (S) national president Anupriya Patel. Anupriya Patel is a Union minister and MP from Mirzapur, while Ashish Patel is a minister in the Yogi Adityanath government. ‘Our shared efforts will continue to move forward’ After the meeting, Sanjay Nishad wrote on X that he warmly welcomed Ashish Patel, a senior NDA ally and Cabinet minister in the Uttar Pradesh government, at his Lucknow residence. He said they discussed the effective implementation of public welfare schemes, social participation and issues of public interest. Nishad added the two leaders also held positive discussions on strengthening organisational coordination between their parties down to the booth level. He further said their shared resolve was to work for the comprehensive uplift of exploited, deprived and backward sections, the future of young people, social justice and strengthening the rights of weaker sections of society. He also stated that efforts to build an empowered society, a strong organisation and a developed Uttar Pradesh would continue with renewed strength. Sanjay Nishad met Mata Prasad on Monday A day earlier, on Monday (14 Sept) evening, Minister Sanjay Nishad had met Leader of the Opposition Mata Prasad Pandey. Nishad visited the Samajwadi Party leader’s residence in Lucknow and presented him with a bouquet. He also shared photographs of the meeting on social media, describing it as a courtesy meeting during which various issues were discussed. ‘We will consider other options if BJP shuts its doors’ Nishad had said, “When the Samajwadi Party shut its doors, we joined the BJP. Now, if the BJP also shuts its doors, we will consider other options. We will remain with whoever resolves the issues of the Nishad community.” Explaining his meeting with Mata Prasad Pandey, Nishad said the Leader of the Opposition was unwell, which was why he had visited him. He said they discussed the demand for Scheduled Caste reservation for the Nishad community. Nishad also said that he had met BJP state general secretary (organisation) Dharampal Singh at the BJP office the previous evening. According to him, discussions were also held on the distribution of tickets for the upcoming Assembly elections. ‘Vinod murder case also discussed with Mata Prasad’ Sanjay Nishad said he also discussed the Vinod murder case in Gonda with Leader of the Opposition Mata Prasad Pandey. According to Nishad, Pandey told him that he had demonstrated his commitment to fighting for the Nishad community. Pandey also said there was a significant Nishad population in his Assembly constituency. He claimed that many of them had earlier supported the Samajwadi Party but had shifted their support to the Nishad Party after its formation. ‘Vinod case could have been prevented with SC reservation’ Nishad said he told Pandey that if the Nishad community had been included in the Scheduled Caste category, the Vinod murder case would not have occurred. He argued that people would have been deterred by the provisions of the SC/ST Act. Nishad also raised the demand that the notification issued on December 25, 2016, to include the Nishad community in the Scheduled Caste category should not have been withdrawn. He said the notification was withdrawn just five days after it was issued. ‘Courtesy meeting’ or pressure politics ahead of UP polls? Two interpretations are emerging in political circles over Sanjay Nishad’s meeting with Samajwadi Party leader and Leader of the Opposition Mata Prasad Pandey. The first is that Nishad visited Pandey simply to enquire about his health, as Pandey was unwell. The second is that, with the 2027 Assembly elections approaching, Nishad is seeking a larger share of seats for his party and is using the meeting to signal his bargaining position within the NDA. The timing of the meeting has also fuelled political speculation. Political observers have linked Nishad’s recent statements to the seat-sharing negotiations. Nishad has publicly indicated that he could reconsider his options if the BJP “shuts its doors”, while his Nishad Party is seeking more seats in the 2027 election, particularly in constituencies where the BJP lost in the previous election. The Nishad Party was part of the BJP-led NDA in the 2022 Uttar Pradesh Assembly election. Under the seat-sharing arrangement, it was allocated 16 seats. It contested 10 seats on its own symbol and won six, while six candidates contested on the BJP symbol, five of whom won. This gave the Nishad Party 11 MLAs after the election. Among them was Dr Vinod Kumar Bind, who had won the Majhwan seat in Mirzapur on a Nishad Party ticket. He resigned as MLA in 2024 to contest the Bhadohi Lok Sabha election. The Nishad Party currently has five MLAs. Nishad community has significant electoral presence in UP Political estimates put the core Nishad population at around 4.5–5% of Uttar Pradesh’s electorate, although estimates vary depending on which related riverine communities are included. There is no recent official caste census providing a definitive figure. The broader Nishad identity includes communities and sub-groups such as Mallah, Bind, Manjhi, Kahar, Dhimar, Kashyap and others. Their electoral influence is linked not only to their overall population but also to their concentration in several constituencies. The community has a strong presence across parts of eastern and central Uttar Pradesh, including Gorakhpur, Mau, Ghazipur, Ballia, Sant Kabir Nagar, Mirzapur, Bhadohi, Prayagraj, Varanasi, Jaunpur and Fatehpur. Political estimates suggest that Nishad voters can influence electoral outcomes in more than 160 Assembly constituencies, with a particularly substantial presence in around 80 seats. Read about the occasions when Sanjay Nishad targeted the government Nishad Party had allied with SP in 2018 In 2018, the Nishad Party had allied with the Samajwadi Party. Sanjay Nishad’s son, Praveen Nishad, contested the Gorakhpur Lok Sabha by-election on an SP ticket and won, entering the Lok Sabha. However, a year later, in 2019, the Nishad Party joined the BJP-led alliance.
