stories.title: Teacher assaulted over taking dog into lift:Woman's hair pulled, slapped, hit with stick; guard intervenes and escorts her to flat
stories.summary: Two women got into a physical altercation at Ghaziabad's Windsor Paradise Society over taking a dog in the lift. The woman accompanying the dog allegedly stopped a schoolteacher from entering the lift. When the teacher objected, she pulled her hair, beat her with a stick and slapped her several times. The society's guard tried to intervene, but the dispute did not end. Later, he himself escorted the teacher from the lift to her flat. The incident took place on Saturday, and CCTV footage emerged on Sunday. The victim, a teacher, has filed a complaint at Nandgram police station, seeking action. Police are investigating the case. See some pictures related to the incident... Read the details... Hina Bari lives with her family in Windsor Paradise-2. She is a teacher at a school in Indirapuram. At around 3 pm on September 12, she returned from school and reached the society. Hina said that Shweta Sube was already in the lift with her pet dog. “She told me to take another lift. I said I would stand to the side. When I tried to enter the lift, she started arguing with me.” First hit her with a stick, then slapped her According to the victim, when the dispute escalated, Shweta hit me with a stick. When I tried to stop her, she started slapping me and threatened me while hurling abuse. The society guard came to intervene during the incident. Despite this, the assault continued. CCTV footage shows the pushing and assault between the two women. Police register a case Following the incident, Hina Bari submitted a written complaint at Nandgram police station. She has asked the police to investigate the matter and register an FIR against the woman accused, as well as take legal action. The police are investigating the matter on the basis of CCTV footage and the complaint. They have registered a case under an NCR, or non-cognisable report. Meanwhile, following the incident, the issue of taking pet dogs in lifts in the society and the disputes arising over it is once again being discussed. Now, here is the key information... Conflicts over pet dogs are common in apartments and housing societies. Incidents of dogs biting or frightening people in lifts, parks or children's play areas continue to be reported. This often leads to arguments or disputes between pet owners and their neighbours. This incident in Ghaziabad is a precise example of that. If you keep a pet in an apartment or housing society, it is important to know your rights and those of your pet.

stories.title: Elderly man killed for objecting to wrong-side driving:Son breaks down outside Lucknow police station, lies in front of hearse
stories.summary: Elderly man was stabbed to death outside a police station in Lucknow on Saturday. His only fault was that he had reprimanded a young man for coming from the wrong side of the road. On Sunday morning, after the post-mortem, the elderly man’s body was being taken in a hearse for cremation. His family members became angry during the journey. His son lay down on the ground in front of the vehicle and began beating his chest and crying. He was calmed down with great difficulty. At around 4:20 pm, police arrested Rajkumar alias Malai (40), who allegedly killed the elderly man. He is a resident of Lakhimpur Kheri and a history-sheeter. He had been absconding for eight years. Meanwhile, police from two stations were deployed during the funeral procession to maintain law and order. The incident took place in the Madiyaon police station area. See 2 pictures- Know the full case… Stabbed after being stopped for coming from the wrong side Magan Bihari Tiwari, a resident of Bharat Nagar in Madiyaon, was going to pay his electricity bill with his grandson, Sankalp Tiwari, on Saturday. He was sitting pillion on the motorcycle. As Sankalp was passing in front of Madiyaon police station, a street vendor suddenly came towards them from the wrong side. Sankalp asked him, “Where are you coming from this side?” The vendor became angry as soon as he heard this and attacked Sankalp with a knife. Magan Bihari, who was sitting behind his grandson on the motorcycle, got off to protect him. The vendor then left Sankalp and attacked his grandfather, Magan Bihari, with the knife. He stabbed Magan Bihari five times with full force in the abdomen and chest. The injuries were so severe that pieces of flesh were exposed. He collapsed and died at the spot. Following the incident, the family was inconsolable. As soon as she received the information, his eldest daughter, Poonam, also reached the hospital. She broke down in tears after seeing her father’s body. The incident took place at 1 p.m. under the flyover in front of Madiyaon police station. Now read what happened today… Police from two stations and PAC deployed during funeral procession On Sunday, the family began taking Magan Bihari’s body for cremation. As the vehicle left the house at around 11 am, the family members stopped it. However, police were already on alert after local leaders had visited the area the previous day. Police from two stations — Madiyaon and Saripur — along with PAC personnel, were deployed at the spot for security. As a result, the situation did not escalate. Police assured Magan Bihari’s family that prompt action would be taken. The family then agreed and proceeded to take the body for cremation. Elderly man retired from municipal corporation 16 years ago Magan Bihari Tiwari retired from the municipal corporation in 2010. He worked as a supervisor in the RR department. His family includes his wife, Maya Tiwari, son Pradeep Tiwari, daughter-in-law Pushpa, and three grandchildren. At the time of the incident, his eldest grandson, Sankalp Tiwari, was with him. Sankalp is currently studying in Class 12. Son is also a municipal corporation supervisor Magan Bihari’s son, Pradeep Tiwari, is also a supervisor in Zone 2 of the municipal corporation. He said, “I was at the office when my mother called and told me that my father’s health had deteriorated. She asked me to come to Highway Hospital. When I reached there, I found out that someone had stabbed my father. He had gone out with my son to pay the electricity bill.” SP leader Pooja Shukla visited the family late at night As soon as she learnt about the incident, SP leader Pooja Shukla reached the victim’s home late on Saturday night. She spoke to the family and assured them of all possible assistance. She also said that the administration should provide financial aid to the victim’s family. ADCP North Naveen Kumar Singh said, Magan Bihari Tiwari and his grandson, Sankalp Tiwari, got into an argument with a man on the road. The same man attacked both of them with a knife, following which Magan Bihari died. His grandson is undergoing treatment in serious condition. Rajkumar alias Malai, who carried out the knife attack, has been arrested. He is a history-sheeter from Lakhimpur.

stories.title: CM Yogi joins Pradeep Mishra’s religious discourse:Says, ‘As long as such kathas continue, no one can harm us’
stories.summary: Pradeep Mishra's Shiv Puran Katha is currently being held in Rae Bareli. The katha is being organised by Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Minister Manoj Kumar Pandey. Chief Minister Yogi attended the katha at around 1:15 p.m. on Sunday. Pradeep Mishra garlanded Yogi and blessed him. Yogi said, "As long as such sacred kathas and religious events continue to be held in India, no country or culture will be able to harm it in the slightest." Before addressing the devotees from the stage, Yogi raised the slogans, "Victory to Siyavar Ramchandra" and "Victory to Pawanputra Hanuman." Earlier, when Yogi arrived, Minister Manoj Kumar Pandey, the district's in-charge minister Rakesh Sachan and a large number of BJP workers welcomed him. Read what CM Yogi said... 1 - Fulfilment of wishes comes with devotion In Sanatan Dharma, those who attain devotion in life have all their wishes fulfilled. Awadh is the sacred land where Lord Hanuman attained unwavering devotion to Lord Ram in the Ramayana. Food, clothing and lifestyle may change when one moves to a different place, but devotion in the heart remains the same. The Jyotirlingas established across the country reflect India's political and cultural unity. 2- Lord Shiva, the deity of public welfare and prosperity Explaining the form of Lord Shiva, the Chief Minister said, "Shiva is the deity of public welfare and prosperity. He removes negativity and paves the way for the welfare of society. A positive and devotional atmosphere is essential for the progress and strength of society." 3- Agreed to the organisation of the religious discourse without any hesitation CM Yogi also shared an anecdote related to the discourse. He said that Minister Manoj Kumar Pandey had expressed his wish to organise the discourse and told him that he had spoken to the discourse narrator, Pandit Pradeep Mishra. Yogi said he immediately agreed to organise the discourse without any hesitation. He expressed his special gratitude to the devotees, the organising committee and the discourse narrator, Pandit Pradeep Mishra, for this divine event. Shiv Puran discourse to continue until 17 September The Shiv Puran discourse began on 11 September and will continue until 17 September. A large number of devotees from nearby districts, besides Raebareli, are attending the discourse, which is being held daily from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. They include people from Prayagraj, Pratapgarh, Sultanpur, Amethi and other districts. Tight security within a 5km radius Security arrangements at the venue were tightened ahead of Chief Minister Yogi's visit. Police forces were deployed at every point within a five-kilometre radius of the venue. Separate parking arrangements have been made for vehicles carrying devotees attending the event. Separate parking areas have been created for large and small vehicles. Vehicles are being parked around two kilometres before the venue so that traffic around the event site is not affected. Last year, Yogi attended Pradeep Mishra's discourse in Kashi Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath also attended Pradeep Mishra's religious discourse in Kashi in November 2025. At the time, a seat for CM Yogi was placed right next to Pt Pradeep Mishra. Yogi had said, “Who says we are divided among ourselves? Where is casteism, and where is the dispute over methods of worship? This discourse is proof that we are all united in our commitment to nationalism. As a religious warrior, it conveys the message of our cultural unity and nation-building.”

stories.title: Rajnath Singh returns silver crown to Khatik community:Tells Agra gathering to turn it into anklets for a poor girl
stories.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said in Agra on Sunday, "Some people try to incite others to serve their political interests-sometimes in the name of caste and sometimes in the name of religion. They try to create divisions in our society." But we must resolve that we will not be swayed by anyone. We will not allow society to be divided. We will all work together to ensure that there is love and cooperation in society, and a spirit of standing by one another in times of happiness and sorrow. Remember, division makes us fall apart, while unity makes us flourish. At the conference, the Khatik community placed a silver crown on Rajnath Singh's head. However, he returned it. He said, "I accept everything, but I am returning this silver crown to you. If a poor couple's daughter is leaving for her marital home after her wedding and does not have silver anklets on her feet, have this crown melted down and get anklets made for her." Rajnath Singh arrived at Kheria Airport at 1:30 p.m. on a special aircraft. Union minister S.P. Singh Baghel, Uttar Pradesh minister Baby Rani Maurya and officials welcomed him there. Know the Defence Minister's five key points... Everyone's goal is the same - to protect religion and the nation People who view Hinduism only through the lens of caste fail to understand its core essence. Our system is based on duties. Under it, one person can have several duties, while several people can have the same duty. But everyone's goal is the same - to protect religion and the nation. Praise for the Khatik community When Direct Action Day was announced in 1946 and Hindus began to be targeted in Bengal, many members of the Khatik community, led by Gopal Patha, took charge. They worked to protect the Hindus. A Khatik is one who can make even fear afraid Whatever the time, whatever the challenge and however powerful the enemy, the Khatik community has never accepted retreating from the defence of religion and the nation's honour. It can also be said that a Khatik is one who can make even fear afraid. A Khatik is one who stands at the forefront in times of danger. A Khatik is one who protects others despite enduring hardship himself. Uttar Pradesh is developing rapidly Today, Uttar Pradesh too is rapidly advancing on the path of development under the double-engine government. Recall that there was a time when mafia rule prevailed in Uttar Pradesh. The roads were uneven. There was an atmosphere of insecurity. People lived in fear, and riots took place frequently. UP used to make headlines for criminals Today, Uttar Pradesh is known for development. It is known for world-class infrastructure. The state that once made headlines for criminals is now building industrial corridors. It is expanding its metro rail network. Work on expanding the Agra Metro is also progressing rapidly. See 4 pictures... The All India Khatik Samaj organised a divisional-level Khatik Garjana Conference. Around 1,500 people attended it. The conference discussed political participation, social unity and the role of the Khatik community in the upcoming elections. The Khatik community has considerable influence over the Assembly seats in Firozabad, Shikohabad, Tundla and Agra districts in the Agra division. There are between 1 lakh and 2.5 lakh voters here.

stories.title: 10-year-old boy burnt to death in Sitapur:Mother also dies in short-circuit fire; child taken to hospital wrapped in a bedsheet
stories.summary: Fire broke out in a house in Sitapur due to a short circuit, killing a 10-year-old child and his mother after they suffered burn injuries. The child's entire body was burnt to ashes, and his tongue had protruded. He was wrapped in a sheet and taken to the community health centre, where doctors declared him dead. His mother also died during treatment. Meanwhile, his 17-year-old sister remains in critical condition. She is undergoing treatment at the trauma centre in Lucknow. The incident took place at 6 a.m. on Sunday in Mishrikh Kotwali. The woman's husband and elder son had gone to open their grocery shop, while the son and daughter were sleeping in the room. See two pictures taken after the incident... Read the full incident in sequence... Fire caused by a short circuit Kamlesh lives with his family in a three-room house in Gopalpur village. His wife, Gauri (40), sons Suraj (13) and Krishna (10), and daughter Kajal (17) were at home. Kamlesh runs a grocery shop. His shop is about 20 metres from the house. His elder son Suraj said, "At around 6 a.m., my father and I went to open the shop. My mother, younger brother Krishna and sister Kajal were sleeping in the first room adjoining the veranda. A short circuit then occurred in the meter board. The wires burned and fell on the straw. The straw began to smoulder. A five-litre can containing diesel was kept nearby. Once the fire reached the diesel, it quickly intensified." Inspector took them to hospital in his jeep Suraj said, "Meanwhile, my mother woke up and raised the alarm. Hearing the screams, my father and I also arrived. Villagers gathered at the scene. People began extinguishing the fire and pulled all three of us out. By then, my brother had been burned to ashes. My father and I began losing consciousness. The villagers somehow managed to support us both." After this, the villagers informed the police, fire brigade and ambulance services. Inspector Pradeep Kumar Singh reached the scene and took the injured to hospital in his official jeep. About half an hour later, the fire brigade arrived at the scene and brought the fire under control. Mother and son die All three were seriously burned in the accident. They were immediately taken to the CHC, where Krishna was declared dead. Gauri and Kajal were referred to the district hospital. Given their critical condition, both were referred from the district hospital to the Lucknow Trauma Centre. Gauri died during treatment at 10 a.m. on Sunday. Meanwhile, the girl remains in critical condition. ASP Durgesh Kumar Singh said, “Two people died in the fire. The girl suffered burns and is undergoing treatment. The forensic team has collected evidence. The cause of the fire will be determined after the investigation.”

stories.title: Constable dies after shooting himself with service rifle:He was on guard duty at Hapur police station after returning from 15-days leave
stories.summary: A constable on guard duty at a police station in Hapur died after being hit by a bullet fired from his service rifle. The bullet struck his chest. Other police personnel reached the spot after hearing the gunshot, but the constable had died by then. The incident took place at around 11 a.m. on Sunday in the Dhaulana police station area, around 40 kilometres from the district headquarters. The Additional SP said the constable had shot himself with his service rifle and died by suicide. The constable was identified as 23-year-old Ashish Verma, a resident of Hirapur village in the Nibohra police station area of Agra. He joined the Uttar Pradesh Police in 2025. He received his first posting at Dhaulana police station in April 2026. The initial investigation suggests that the constable was under mental stress. However, the official cause of death has not yet been established. It is being discussed that the constable had spoken to someone over the phone before shooting himself. It is also being said that he had a loan. See the pictures... Here is the full story... Constable Ashish's family lives in Heerapur village in the Nibohara police station area of Agra. His father, Tribhuvan Nath, is a farmer. Besides his mother, Rajkumari, the family includes two sisters and a brother. His elder sister, Sundari, is married, while his younger sister, Bhavna, and younger brother, Santosh, are studying. Ashish was not yet married. His uncle, Mukesh Kumar, said, "The police station called on Sunday morning. We were told that Ashish had shot himself and died. We were told that he was under stress. But we do not know what was troubling him." The family was devastated as soon as they received the news of their son's death. His relatives left for Hapur. Villagers said the family had been happy after Ashish joined the police force. His sudden death has cast a pall of grief over the entire village. He had gone to his village on 15 days' leave Constable Ashish Verma had gone to Hirapur village on leave for around 15 days. He returned three days before his leave was due to end. However, he did not immediately report for duty and rested in the police quarters at the station. According to his fellow police personnel, he reported for duty on Friday. He was assigned duty at Pilkhuwa intersection on Saturday On Saturday, Ashish was assigned duty at Pilkhuwa intersection. He was responsible for ensuring the security of vehicles and keeping traffic moving smoothly there. On Sunday, he was performing guard duty at the police station. Gunshot fired shortly after phone call According to his fellow police personnel, Ashish was speaking to someone on the phone while on sentry duty on Sunday morning. A short while after the call ended, they heard a gunshot. Panic broke out on the police station premises. His fellow police personnel reached the spot and took Ashish to hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Stress and loan also discussed Initial investigations suggest that Ashish was under mental stress. It is being discussed that he had spoken to someone on the phone before shooting himself. It is also being said that he had a substantial loan outstanding. According to villagers, the constable had taken a loan of ₹15 lakh. However, these claims have not been officially confirmed, and the cause of death is being investigated. Investigation under way into why constable shot himself: ASP ASP Vineet Bhatnagar said, Prima facie, it has emerged that the constable shot himself while on duty. The constable died of the gunshot wound. All aspects related to the incident are currently being investigated.

stories.title: Female bouncer arrested in Jaipur for threatening Shamli leader:Claimed Lawrence Bishnoi as husband, issued death threats over disparaging remarks
stories.summary: A woman who allegedly threatened to kill people in Shamli while claiming to be Lawrence Bishnoi's wife has been arrested by the police in Jaipur after she allegedly threatened Mukul Chaudhary, Shamli district president of the youth wing of the All India Jat Mahasabha, and YouTuber Neeraj Sharma over the phone on September 7. The Uttar Pradesh Police brought the woman, identified as Bindu Devi, a resident of Buxar in Bihar who works as a bouncer in Jaipur, from Jaipur to Shamli on Saturday; she also has a tattoo bearing Lawrence Bishnoi's name on her hand. Bindu Devi said- "I have considered Lawrence Bishnoi my husband for eight years. I have never met him. I will meet him whenever I get the opportunity. I will wait for him for lifetimes. If anyone says anything wrong about him, I will take revenge." Read the full case... The thirteenth-day ceremony for Haryanvi singer Ankit Baliyan, a resident of Shamli, was held on 2 September. Mukul Chaudhary, district president of the youth wing of the Jat Mahasabha, also attended to pay tribute. He had commented on Lawrence Bishnoi and his gang on a YouTube channel. YouTuber Neeraj Sharma had shared this video on his Facebook page. Bindu Devi, a bouncer living in Jaipur, then commented on Facebook and obtained Neeraj's phone number. She threatened Mukul Chaudhary and Neeraj Sharma over the phone with murder for running a report against Lawrence Bishnoi. Mother of 5 arrested in Jaipur YouTuber Neeraj Sharma and Mukul Chaudhary had lodged a complaint with Shamli's SP on 9 September. A case was registered on the SP's instructions. After tracing the woman's location, a police team reached Kartarpur in Jaipur. She was arrested from there. The police brought her to Shamli on 12 September. Bindu is from Bihar and a mother of five Superintendent of Police Narendra Pratap Singh said Bindu Devi is originally from Buxar in Bihar. She had been living in Jaipur after divorcing her husband eight years ago. She worked as a bouncer for a security agency. She has four daughters and one son. Police also recovered the mobile phone from the woman that was used to issue the threat. Told police, "I will teach you a lesson if you speak falsely about Lawrence" The woman told the police, "Lawrence is my husband. If anyone says anything wrong about him, I will teach them a lesson. These people (Mukul Chaudhary) were also speaking wrongly about him. There is no evidence for the allegations against Lawrence. If Lawrence has committed a crime, punish him, but no one has the right to speak wrongly about him."

stories.title: Mayawati dismisses rumours about ill health:Says, 'I am absolutely fine'; claims Akash is still being controlled by his father-in-law
stories.summary: BSP supremo Mayawati has dismissed reports that she is unwell. Speaking at a press conference in Lucknow, she said, “I am completely healthy. I am carrying out my work.” Mayawati said, People who have been expelled from the party are spreading the misconception that I am ill, which is why I am sharing information about even major issues directly through posts on X. This is why I have come before you today. She said, “Proof of this is that party in-charge Alok Kumar received a call from my nephew Akash Anand at 10:04 pm on Saturday. He asked, ‘Is Behenji unwell? How is her health?’” Alok Kumar said, “She is absolutely fine and busy with her work.” Akash then told Alok Kumar, “Don’t tell Behenji that I asked this,” and hung up. This is a serious matter. Mayawati said, “Akash’s mindset may be right or wrong. Even now, he is not acting on his own judgement; rather, he is acting according to the thinking of his father-in-law, Ashok Siddharth. Akash has still not become politically mature, which is why he was relieved of his responsibilities in the party.” In fact, Mayawati was seen in public in Lucknow on September 3. She had held a meeting with BSP leaders. Since then, she has been sharing information about her decisions through posts on X. Mayawati had hinted at handing over the party to her niece Four days ago, Mayawati had set a condition for restoring Akash’s party position: his father-in-law and former MP Ashok Siddharth would have to retire from politics. Seventeen hours later, Ashok Siddharth announced his retirement. Even after this, Mayawati did not give Akash a position in the party. She expelled him from the party through a post on X. She also alleged that Akash was more attached to his father-in-law than to the party and its mission. On Saturday, Mayawati again shared a lengthy and emotional post on X. In it, she announced that not only Akash but also Ishan would not be given any position in the party. She hinted at handing over the party reins to her niece, Deepika Anand. Major reshuffle in BSP, country divided into 3 sectors Mayawati also announced major changes in the party to expand its support base. As part of the changes, the post of Chief Sector In-charge in the BSP has been abolished. Mayawati had earlier given this responsibility to Akash’s younger brother, Ishan. However, she later announced that Ishan would also not be given any position in the party. Mayawati has divided the country into three sectors. The first sector comprises Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand, which she will lead herself. She has divided the remaining 19 states into two sectors. Sector 1 has 10 states, while Sector 2 has nine states. Two in-charges have been appointed for each sector. Ramji Gautam and Suresh Rao have been given responsibility for the 10 states in Sector 1. States: Delhi, Haryana, Punjab/Chandigarh, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Bihar and Jharkhand. Rajaram and Atar Singh Rao have been given responsibility for the nine states in Sector 2. States: West Bengal, Odisha, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and Kerala. Mayawati makes three major points 1- China border dispute should be resolved soon Mayawati said the 18th BRICS summit held in Delhi issued a 140-paragraph declaration with the consent of all member countries, calling it a major diplomatic achievement. She said several countries are currently facing wars, tensions and economic crises. In such a situation, the BRICS countries coming together reflects mutual cooperation and understanding. She said efforts to strengthen economic ties among BRICS nations are also encouraging. Taking steps towards creating a BRICS currency would be a positive move. Mayawati said time will tell what results emerge from efforts to prevent differences with China from turning into a dispute. However, the border dispute between the two countries should be resolved at the earliest. 2- Government should consider demands of 58,000 panchayat assistants Mayawati also raised the issue of panchayat assistants protesting at Lucknow’s Eco Garden. She said around 58,000 panchayat assistants have been demonstrating in the state capital for the past few days, demanding an increase in honorarium and permanent employment instead of contractual appointments. She said the state government should consider their legitimate demands. 3- Tough decisions benefiting the party Mayawati said the tough decisions recently taken in the interest of the party and the movement are yielding positive results. She said the unfinished mission of Babasaheb Ambedkar and BSP founder Kanshi Ram is now moving forward rapidly. She said the party organisation in states other than Uttar Pradesh has been divided into two sectors, with senior leaders appointed as central in-charges. National vice-president Anand Kumar will also hold review meetings and assess their work.

stories.title: Yogi government releases ₹6.55 cr:Focus on tracking children in council schools; progress of every child to be monitored
stories.summary: The Yogi government has released ₹6.55 crore to improve monitoring of the educational progress and enrolment of children studying in Uttar Pradesh's council-run schools. The funds will be spent on operating the MIS (U-DISE Plus) and Child Tracking System. The government's objective is to organise school data more systematically and effectively monitor the educational status of every child. Funds to be spent at school level The School Education Department has sent instructions to all district basic education officers regarding the utilisation and monitoring of the funds. Of the total ₹6.55 crore, ₹2.62 crore has been released for the MIS (U-DISE Plus) and ₹3.93 crore for the Child Tracking System. The funds will be spent on the designated activities through school management committees (SMCs). Every child's record to be tracked digitally According to the department, data related to schools and students will be collected and analysed through U-DISE Plus. The Child Tracking System will be used to continuously monitor children's educational status. The government is also focusing on linking each student's unique APAAR ID to the Child Tracking System, so that all information related to their education remains available on a single platform. Monitoring to take place at district level The instructions ask district basic education officers to regularly review the use of funds and ensure monitoring based on the data available on the portal. The department believes this will strengthen both data management and accountability at the school level. Efforts to make school management accountable The Education Department says that the growing use of digital systems will make information on children's enrolment, attendance and academic progress in schools available more accurately. This will also make it easier to implement and monitor schemes. What the minister and officials said Minister of State for Basic Education (Independent Charge) Sandeep Singh also shared his views on the matter. "The government is working towards making the school system more transparent and accountable. The MIS and child-tracking system will enable better use of information related to children." Meanwhile, School Education Director General Monica Rani said that effective use of APAAR ID, U-DISE Plus and the Child Tracking System must be ensured. She also said that transparent use of the funds provided at the SMC level and regular monitoring were essential.

stories.title: Rape allegations against Mohammed Shami's brother in Lucknow:Woman says marriage was promised after IPL selection, first met on flight
stories.summary: A Lucknow woman has accused Mohammed Kaif, brother of cricketer Mohammed Shami, of repeatedly having sexual relations with her on the promise of marriage. She alleged that Kaif assured her that he would marry her, prompting her to leave her job as cabin crew with an airline in Delhi. She further claimed that whenever she asked him about the marriage, he would call her to different cities and allegedly have sexual relations with her. "Mohammed Kaif had sexual relations with me several times after promising to marry me. After being assured that we would get married, I even left my job. Whenever I spoke about marriage, he would call me and have sexual relations with me again. I am now fighting for justice. He cannot silence my voice using his influence and position," the woman alleged. The woman said the two first connected on Instagram in 2020. Before entering into a relationship, she told Kaif that she was divorced and had a son. According to her, he told her that he had no objection to her past or her child. She alleged that Kaif told her, "I love you very much and I will marry only you." She said she trusted his assurance and subsequently left her job as cabin crew with an airline company in Delhi. The woman told Dainik Bhaskar that the two would meet while travelling and that their relationship gradually became closer. She said that when she reminded him about his promise to marry her, he would allegedly call her to whichever city he was in. Woman Alleges Sexual Relations in Lucknow, Delhi and Kolkata The woman told Dainik Bhaskar: "Mohammed Kaif had sexual relations with me for several months in Lucknow, Delhi and Kolkata. When he stopped answering my calls, I spoke to his elder brother, Mohammed Haseeb. He initially said he would speak to Kaif and get back to me. After that, he too started threatening me, saying that I could complain wherever I wanted. I would not be able to do anything." She has submitted complaints at Ashiyana and Vibhuti Khand police stations and later approached the DCP East's office, seeking registration of an FIR against Mohammed Kaif and legal action. First Face-to-Face Meeting Took Place in 2023 The woman said she met Kaif in person for the first time in Ghaziabad on 11 September 2023. She claimed that he had expressed his desire to marry her in August that year. She said that while Kaif was playing in Delhi, he called her to hotels several times and that she stayed with him for several days. A few months later, when she again raised the issue of marriage, she alleged that he called her to Kolkata, where they stayed at a hotel. Woman Alleges Incident at Hotel Hyatt in Lucknow The woman claimed that Kaif had told her they would get married after the IPL auction and had even sworn on the Quran. On 11 October 2024, Bengal's Ranji team came to Lucknow, and Kaif was with the team. She alleged that he called her to Hotel Hyatt in Gomti Nagar, where they had sexual relations. The woman said, "Today, Mohammed Kaif and his elder brother are threatening me. My complaint is not being registered at any police station. If I am standing on the streets and raising my voice today, it is because I have been wronged. I want to tell the police that my complaint should be registered. If the investigation finds me guilty, I should also be punished." She Claims She Left Her Job After Promise of Marriage According to the woman, Kaif asked her to leave her job and assured her that he would marry her. She said she trusted him and resigned from her cabin crew position. However, she alleged that the marriage never took place. She had expected the marriage to happen after the IPL auction in December 2025, but it did not. When she pressed him for marriage in January 2026, she claimed that he began distancing himself and eventually stopped communicating with her. Woman Says She Approached Kaif’s Brother The woman said she approached Kaif's elder brother, Mohammed Haseeb, to discuss the marriage. She alleged that Haseeb initially told her that he would speak to Kaif and get back to her, but later began calling her a "honey trapper". After what she described as continued harassment, the woman said she spoke about her experience on a sports channel podcast on 29 April 2026. She alleged that 10 days later, on 9 May, Kaif called her and asked her to have the podcast removed. According to her, he again assured her that he would speak to his family and marry her, before calling her to Kolkata. She alleged that after reaching Kolkata, Kaif again assured her of marriage and had sexual relations with her several times. Woman Alleges Threats During Meeting in Amroha The woman alleged that Kaif had sexual relations with her on 18 May. The following day, she was called to a man's house in Amroha to discuss the marriage. According to her, Kaif's elder brother, his mother and other people were present. She alleged that Haseeb threatened her during the meeting and claimed that the family had influence at very high levels. The woman said, “On 30 May, I told Kaif about everything that had happened in Amroha. He did not help me and also refused to marry me.” Complaint Taken Up by ACP Vibhuti Khand The woman said she first approached Ashiyana police station because she had previously lived in that area. However, she alleged that police told her the matter did not fall under their jurisdiction. She then approached Vibhuti Khand police station, stating that the hotel where she had stayed with Kaif falls under its jurisdiction. After she said she received no relief from either police station, she submitted a complaint to DCP East, Lucknow. The investigation has now been handed over to the ACP Vibhuti Khand. The woman has also recorded her statement in connection with the case.

stories.title: 40-year-old MS doctor dies by suicide after injecting himself:Took injection from OT in Kashi, locked room after row with wife
stories.summary: A 40-year-old doctor died by injecting himself with a poisonous substance in Varanasi. When police broke open the door and entered on Saturday, they found the doctor lying on the bed. A poisonous injection was lying nearby. The police's preliminary investigation has found that the doctor had been having a dispute with his wife. The doctor saw patients in the outpatient department on Saturday and then went to his accommodation. After speaking to his wife on the phone in the evening, the dispute between them escalated. When the doctor did not go to the canteen for dinner at night, a security guard knocked on his room door. When there was no response, he informed the doctor's fellow doctors and the police. The police then reached the spot, broke open the door and entered. Dr Gautam Shubhankar had been working as a urologist at the Heritage Institute of Medical Science for three years. He was from Bihar. He had got married five years ago. First, here is the full sequence of events As a result, Dr Gautam lived alone in residence number 802 on the campus and ate at the hospital canteen. On Saturday, the doctor saw patients in the OPD and then went to his residence. He did not return to the hospital until evening. After speaking to his wife on his mobile phone in the evening, an intense argument broke out between them, following which the doctor decided to take his own life. He then went to the hospital's OT, took an injection along with a syringe and returned to his residence. When the doctor's room remained locked until 10 p.m. and he did not go to the canteen for dinner, the security guard became suspicious. He informed the staff and called doctors from nearby. When he did not come out of the room for a long time, his fellow doctors became suspicious. They checked the room and found that the door was locked from inside. When there was no movement despite calling his mobile phone several times and knocking on the door, they looked through the window. The doctor was found lying on the bed in suspicious circumstances. The sight caused panic. Security guard called the police After receiving information about the body on the campus, the security guard informed senior officials, the dean and Rohania police about the incident. The police reached the spot and broke open the door in the presence of the security guard and other medical staff. Police found the doctor's body lying on the bed in the room. An injection and a mobile phone were lying nearby. Along with inspecting the scene, police took the items found in the room into their possession. A preliminary investigation suggested that the doctor had ended his life by injecting himself with a poisonous substance. Doctors on the hospital staff also said that his behaviour had changed a few days earlier and that he had remained troubled. After being informed by police, his family members also left Bihar for Banaras. Doctor injected himself Dr Gautam Shubhankar, a resident of Patna in Bihar, had spoken to his family, details of which were found on his phone. The Rohania police broke open the door of the room and took the body into their possession. In the preliminary investigation, police suspected that the doctor had died by suicide after injecting himself with a poisonous substance. According to police, the initial investigation suggested that he had died by suicide because of family-related reasons. The police have taken the body into custody and sent it for a post-mortem examination. The circumstances and cause of death will become clearer after the post-mortem report. The police are investigating the case and efforts are being made to determine the reasons behind the doctor's suicide.

stories.title: Former Gorakhpur deputy mayor threatened on social media:Accused of defaming and threatening to kill him; FIR registered
stories.summary: Shahpur police in Gorakhpur have registered a case against a youth for allegedly posting objectionable content on social media, following a complaint by former deputy chairman and councillor's representative Brijesh Singh, alias Chhotu, a resident of Rapti Nagar in Shahpur. The youth is accused of attempting to tarnish Brijesh Singh's image through social media posts and also threatening him. Acting on the written complaint, police registered the case and began investigating the matter. Accused of posting due to political animosity In his complaint to police, Brijesh Singh said that Rajat Chaudhary, a resident of Vikas Nagar Japti Tola in Bargadwa, had been continuously running a smear campaign against him on social media. Rajat Chaudhary is the son of former councillor Janardhan Chaudhary. The written complaint alleges that objectionable content was posted on social media with the intention of damaging his image due to political animosity. Accused of issuing threats on Instagram According to the complaint, Rajat Chaudhary posted about Brijesh Singh on Instagram. The post allegedly threatened to knock him to the ground with two slaps. Brijesh Singh asked the police to take action over the post. He alleges that such posts are being used in an attempt to damage his social and political image. Served as councillor and deputy chairperson several times Brijesh Singh has served several terms as a councillor and deputy chairperson of the municipal corporation. His wife is currently the municipal corporation's deputy chairperson as well as a councillor from Raptinagar. It is against the backdrop of this political history that the complaint was filed over the social media post. Police begin investigation Shahpur police have registered a case against the accused, Rajat Chaudhary, based on Brijesh Singh's written complaint. The police are now investigating the social media post, the language used in it and the facts related to the alleged threat. Further action will be taken based on the investigation.

stories.title: Ganga water level falls in Varanasi, 84 ghats lose connectivity:Rain likely for 24 hours; rainfall 18% above average so far
stories.summary: Weather conditions in Varanasi are currently changing. The city recorded a temperature of 28°C on Sunday morning. Clouds have been moving across the sky since morning. Wind speed is around 13 km/h, while humidity was recorded at 85%. The high moisture levels are also causing a noticeable muggy spell. According to meteorologist Manoj Srivastava, Varanasi is likely to receive light drizzle and remain cloudy over the next 24 hours. However, there are no signs of any major weather system becoming active during this period. Localised clouds may bring light rain in some places. The change in weather may also affect temperatures. Rainfall 18 per cent above average This monsoon season, Varanasi has received more rain than normal. So far, rainfall has been around 18% above average. Since 1 June, the city has received 848.8 mm of rain. However, the Ganga's water level has now started to recede, providing some relief to the administration and local residents. According to Central Water Commission data, the Ganga's water level was recorded at 68.81 metres at 6 a.m. on Sunday. If the decline continues, the condition of the ghats is also expected to improve in the coming days. Access to 88 ghats still cut off Despite the falling water level of the Ganga, access to Varanasi's 88 ghats has still not been fully restored. Normal movement of people remains affected at several ghats because water has accumulated there. Although the water level has receded, water is still present in the lower sections of the ghats, prompting authorities to advise people to exercise caution for their safety. The cremation sites at Harishchandra and Manikarnika ghats remain relocated, and only five or six bodies can be cremated at a time.

stories.title: BL Santosh asks BJP-MLAs, ‘How will you win in 2027?’:Why did we lose 2024 LS polls, what is the solution; MPs, MLAs told not to fight each other
stories.summary: The BJP's concern has grown in Uttar Pradesh as Dalit votes have shifted towards the Samajwadi Party. The party will now launch a campaign to reconnect with Dalits. On Saturday, national general secretary (organisation) BL Santosh held a four-hour meeting with MPs, MLAs and district presidents from the Kanpur division. BL Santosh asked the MLAs, How many votes did the BJP candidate receive in your Assembly constituency in the 2024 Lok Sabha election? What was the reason for the defeat wherever the BJP lost? How will you make up for this in 2027, and how will you win the election? The MLAs said that in 2017 and 2019, a large number of Dalit votes that had moved away from the Bahujan Samaj Party came to the BJP. The BJP also received a substantial share of Dalit votes in 2022. However, in 2024, Dalit voters became alienated because of narratives such as the Constitution being changed and reservations being scrapped, and shifted towards the Samajwadi Party. Party leaders acknowledged that the Dalit vote is still shifting towards the Samajwadi Party. This could pose a major challenge for the BJP in the 2027 election. BL Santosh and Dharampal Singh urged party leaders to remain united and fight the Assembly election together. They said there should be no conflict between MLAs and MPs or between MLAs and district presidents. Read BL Santosh's three key points 1- People no longer like VIP culture B.L. Santosh said that people no longer like VIP culture. Convoys of vehicles, sirens and getting tolls waived send the wrong message. This harms the party as well as MPs, MLAs and district presidents. Launch campaigns to bring members of the Dalit community and Dalit leaders into the party. Implement the Ambedkar statue scheme. Organise Sant Ravidas Jayanti programmes effectively and use them to bring Dalits closer to the BJP. 2- Do not limit social media to a photo album B.L. Santosh said that social media is now the biggest political tool. Do not limit it to photographs and albums. Make full use of it in preparing for the elections. It can be used to convey the party's message to the public quickly and effectively. However, social media must not be misused. 3- Get the names of women deleted during SIR reinstated B. L. Santosh said that the names of a large number of voters had been deleted during SIR. This included voters who support the BJP ideology. B. L. Santosh said that the process of adding names was still under way. He directed party workers to have the names of those whose names had been deleted added again. He also raised the issue of the low gender ratio among women voters. He said that after marriage, the names of many women are deleted from the voter lists in their maternal homes but are not added to the lists in their marital homes. He directed party workers to have the names of such women added to the voter list, as women are a major vote bank for the BJP. Meeting lasted 4 hours, defeated candidates were also consulted The meeting lasted from 7 p.m. to 11 p.m. BJP office-bearers from Kanpur Nagar, Kanpur Dehat, Etawah, Kannauj, Auraiya and Farrukhabad attended it. State General Secretary Shankar Lal Lodhi and Kanpur Regional President Ram Kishore Sahu were also present. BL Santosh also spoke to candidates who had lost the 2022 election. He asked them how many votes they had received and by how many votes the victory or defeat was decided.

stories.title: Sumedha from Kashi wins silver for India:Silver medal at World Para Shooting after 18 years; Iran takes gold
stories.summary: Divyang shooter Sumedha Pathak from Varanasi delivered a stellar performance at the World Para Shooting Championships, winning a silver medal for India in the team event. Sumedha and her team will travel to Japan to participate in the Para Asian Games. Sumedha's team achieved this feat in the P-2 category of the 10-metre air pistol event. She was accompanied by Delhi's Bhakti Sharma and Ajmer's Srishti Arora. Sumedha dedicated the medal to Baba Vishwanath and her father. Sumedha said, Now we have to give our best at the Asian Games and win the gold medal for India. First medal in 18 years Brijesh Chandra Pathak, who was present with his daughter Sumedha in Changwon, South Korea, said, Sumedha and her team made history last night by winning a medal at the shooting championship for the first time in 18 years. The competition will continue from 7 September to 15 September. Iran won the gold Brajesh Pathak said, Iran gave India a tough fight in this event. The Iranian team won the competition's gold medal by a narrow margin. Sumedha succeeded in the 2-metre event for India and helped the country win the silver medal in the 10-metre air pistol team event. Dedicated to Baba Vishwanath Sumedha said, I dedicate this medal to Baba Vishwanath and my father. I hope we will aim for gold at the Asian Games. Brajesh Pathak said, Sumedha had already been selected for the Asian Games. She will now leave South Korea for Japan with her team.

stories.title: Tourists fold hands considering Taj Mahal a Shiv Temple:Entered after removing footwear, women say 'this is our Shiv Temple, Bhole Baba is below'
stories.summary: Some tourists who travelled to Agra to see the Taj Mahal are not willing to accept that it is a mausoleum. They believe it is 'Tejo Mahalaya', a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva. Driven by this belief, they were seen folding their hands and bowing their heads before the Taj Mahal. Some women from Mathura and Rajasthan's Dholpur said, "For us, this is not the Taj Mahal but 'Tejo Mahalaya'." As soon as they reached the main gate, they removed their slippers. They bowed their heads and paid their respects. The women also spoke about their faith and beliefs regarding the Taj Mahal. Read ahead to find out what they said and the reason for the controversy. See 2 pictures – Women said, 'This is our Shiva temple' Hindu Mahasabha has also raised the Tejo Mahalaya issue several times The Akhil Bharat Hindu Mahasabha has long claimed that the Taj Mahal is the 'Tejo Mahalaya' Shiva temple. On different occasions, the organisation has also tried to conduct prayers, perform jalabhishek and carry out other religious activities at the Taj Mahal. Dispute over the Taj Mahal has been pending in court since 2015 The dispute over claims that the Taj Mahal is the 'Tejo Mahalaya' Shiva temple has also reached the courts. A case was filed in an Agra court in 2015 in this connection. Lord Shri Agreshwar Mahadev Nagnasheshwar Virajman was made a party to the case. The petitioners demanded that the Taj Mahal be declared a Shiva temple and that Hindus be allowed to worship and offer prayers there. The Union government, the Ministry of Culture, the Ministry of Home Affairs and the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) were also made parties to the case. Later, a demand was also made for the appointment of an advocate commissioner to conduct a survey of the Taj Mahal's closed rooms and premises. Demand for survey rejected in 2019 On 18 July 2019, Agra's Civil Court rejected the demand for the appointment of an advocate commissioner to conduct a survey of the Taj Mahal. The matter was subsequently challenged further. On 4 April, Agra's Additional District Court dismissed the revision petition. The petitioners then approached the Allahabad High Court. On 30 June 2026, a petition was filed in the Allahabad High Court challenging the order of the courts in Agra. It sought the appointment of an advocate commissioner to inspect, photograph and videograph the Taj Mahal. In July 2026, the Allahabad High Court sought responses from the central government and the ASI in the case. Citing 109 alleged historical and archaeological features at the Taj Mahal, the petitioners have claimed that they indicate it was a Hindu temple. Know when controversies arose over the Taj Mahal

stories.title: Encounter the killers just as they killed my father:Slain ex-CRPF jawan's daughter in Ballia says 'we are in terror, who will support us'
stories.summary: "My father deserves respect. He served the country; he did not steal anything. If he had been martyred at the border, he would have received respect. But here, he was killed like a coward." "What do we have left now? Everything we had is gone! My father is dead, and we do not know whether my uncle will survive. Those people will kill my younger brothers too. If they are not killed in a full encounter, we will set ourselves on fire too!" This is the pain of the daughters and family of a former CRPF serviceman in Ballia. Neighbours killed the former CRPF serviceman on Thursday (10 September). They also launched a fatal attack on his brother, who had come to save him. One brother died, while the other is battling for his life in hospital. Six women and two children remain at home. The family is terrified. Everyone has the same question: who will support us now? The funeral was held on the minister's assurance, but the family is angry because no action has been taken against the accused. The case concerns the Ubhawn area, 70 km from the district headquarters. Dainik Bhaskar spoke to the family to find out what caused the incident. Read the full report... See two pictures... First, understand the case... Amresh Bahadur Singh, 45, and his family live in Doth Sonadih in the Belthara Road area. At 9 p.m. on Thursday, neighbours suddenly arrived at his dairy farm. They knocked him down and beat him, then stabbed him several times in the abdomen. When his younger brother reached the spot after hearing the commotion, the attackers also stabbed him in the chest. Both brothers, injured, collapsed on the road. The family took both brothers to hospital, where Amresh, a former CRPF jawan, died. His brother's condition is said to be critical. Police conducted raids that night and detained three accused. Amresh's last rites were performed on Friday, 19 hours after the murder. The families of both brothers lived together in the same house Amresh Bahadur's wife, Kanchan Singh, and their three daughters-Kritika (21), Ritika (17) and Roshni (14)-live at his house. Kritika is in the final year of her graduation. She is due to get married next May. Ritika is in the first year of her B.A., while Roshni is in Class 7. The family of Amresh's brother, Manjesh (35), also lives with him. Manjesh's wife is Ranjana Singh, and they have two sons, Rudra Pratap (10) and Dhruv Pratap (nine). Rudra is in Class 5 and Dhruv is in Class 4. Amresh's badi mummy, Sharda Singh, also lives with them. Took VRS, returned to village and started a dairy with his brother Amresh took VRS on 31 March this year. He then returned to the village and began living with his family. Amresh and Manjesh ran a dairy farm near their home. The family of accused Girish Chandra (50) lived 50 metres from their house. His family comprises his wife Sheela (46), son Ram Karan Singh (25), daughter Khushi (21) and younger son Suraj (18). Ram Karan was released from jail only a month ago. He has a criminal history. Amresh's dairy farm is directly opposite Girish's house. According to the daughter, the story of the night of the incident... His daughter, Ritika Singh, said, "On the night of 10 September, our entire family was at home. Dad was sleeping at the dairy. Suddenly, our neighbour Girish came outside the house with his wife, two sons and daughter. They began hurling abuses. My father woke up and came outside. He asked, 'Whom are you abusing like this?' Girish replied, 'Mind your own business. I am abusing my enemies.'" At the time, the power had gone out across the entire village. It was completely dark. We also ran there. Dad said, "You cannot abuse someone's sister and daughter like this. Name whoever your enemy is." To this, he replied, "I am abusing you. Tell me, what will you do?" All five had come with the intention of murdering him. They were carrying knives and weapons. Uncle stabbed in the stomach while trying to save his nieces As soon as Dad opened the gate and came outside, these people attacked him. Dad was stabbed and fell. They tried to touch me inappropriately, so my uncle immediately stepped forward. Sheela plunged a dagger into my uncle's stomach. All of them were carrying weapons. We could not understand what was happening. When his uncle began shouting, Dad forgot about his own wound and stood up again to save him. He did not even tell them that I had been stabbed. The men stabbed him in the stomach again. His entire abdomen had already been ripped open. Dad collapsed in front of us. After that, my father never got up. Daughter said, "The accused should be killed in an encounter, and we should be provided security" The police have arrested only three accused. Our father had retired from the Army; he had not committed any theft. The accused should be killed in an encounter, and their houses should be demolished. We also need protection from the administration. I have so many younger brothers. These people will come in the future and kill them too. They left after saying that they would wipe out our entire family. The elder daughter is to be married next year These people stole from our house in 2022. There was no major enmity. Our family was doing well, and they were jealous of that. There were two guardians in my home. One of them-our father-is gone...my uncle is on a ventilator. We have nothing left now. My mother is ill, and my elder sister is to be married next year. Who will take on all these responsibilities now? We want all of them killed in an encounter...we want all of them killed in an encounter. Just as my father's and uncle's blood has been spilled, just as my father was killed... we want all of them killed in an encounter. ASP Northern Dinesh Kumar Shukla said ... Three of the five accused-Sheila, Suraj and Khushi-have been arrested. Four police teams are working to arrest the remaining two accused. They too will be arrested soon.

stories.title: ₹100 crore scam in UP government medicines, equipment supply:Former Congress MLA accused; ED probing 7 years of records
stories.summary: An investigation has begun into an alleged ₹100 crore scam in the supply of government medicines and medical equipment in Uttar Pradesh. The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has sought 7-years of records from the UP Medical Supplies Corporation Limited (UPMSCL). The scale of the case can be gauged from the fact that the document seeking the records is marked ‘most urgent’. However, instead of providing the records, the Supplies Corporation has sought permission from the Principal Secretary (Health) to share them. ED officials allege that the department is deliberately delaying the submission of information to allow evidence of the alleged scam to be destroyed. FIRs have already been registered in three districts of Uttar Pradesh, naming former Congress MLA Mukesh Srivastava as the main accused. While the Supplies Corporation has not yet provided the records, the ED already has documents that formed the basis of the FIRs. Read the full report… 5-point year-wise details sought On 13 July, L.K. Verma, Assistant Director of the ED’s Lucknow Zone, wrote to Health Department Director General Dr Pawan Kumar Arun. Citing the FIRs registered in Shravasti and Balrampur, the ED sought five sets of information for 2019-20 to 2025-26: The ED has also sought details of funds released to government hospitals in Shravasti, Bahraich, Gonda and Balrampur from 2013-14 till now, their utilisation and medical reimbursement records. On 16 July, the Director General wrote to the UPMSCL managing director seeking the information. However, instead of providing the records, UPMSCL sought clarification from the Principal Secretary (Health) on whether the purchase- and payment-related documents could be shared. UPMSCL was set up to curb corruption Earlier, government medicines and equipment were purchased at the district level, leading to complaints of corruption and irregularities. To address this, the state government set up UPMSCL in 2018. Since then, most procurement has been carried out through the corporation. The Centre provides funds to states for rural and urban healthcare services through the National Health Mission (NHM). UPMSCL uses these funds to float tenders, purchase medicines and equipment, and supply them to districts. ED entered the case after Mukesh Srivastava’s arrest Former MLA Mukesh Srivastava, alias Gyanendra Pratap Srivastava, has already been arrested in the case linked to the medicines and equipment procurement documents sought by the ED. The agency began its investigation after his arrest. Around 9 companies linked to his family and relatives were found involved in the supply of medicines, equipment, furniture and maintenance work in Bahraich, Balrampur and Shravasti. These companies received contracts worth more than ₹18 crore in these districts. What did the UP Vigilance probe found? According to the allegations, the former MLA allegedly set up fake and unnamed firms and construction companies in the names of family members, relatives and close associates, including the RP Group. These firms allegedly secured contracts worth crores without valid tenders or on the basis of forged documents. The probe alleges that in the Health Department in Balrampur, Shravasti and Gonda, funds for hospital maintenance, medicines and medical equipment were released in full against work that had either not been completed or existed only on paper through fake bills. Mukesh Srivastava is also accused of conspiring with senior Health Department officials, including then CMOs, medical superintendents and clerks. The investigation also found allegations that his companies directly used the department’s GeM portal ID. The former MLA allegedly accumulated assets worth crores, including hotels, farmhouses and plots, during and after his tenure as an MLA from 2012 to 2017, far exceeding his known legitimate sources of income. The Vigilance probe also found that under the Supportive Supervision Scheme, funds meant to operate one vehicle were allegedly withdrawn for three vehicles. The role of then CMO Dr. Ghanshyam Singh also emerged during the investigation. The probe found several instances where tender procedures were allegedly not followed. Printing work was carried out without a tender, while in other cases, despite tenders being issued, the then CMO gave exemptions to Medical Officers In-Charge (MOICs), allegedly violating financial rules. The then CMOs Dr. Ghanshyam Singh, Dr. Satyadev and Dr. Praveen Kumar, along with junior engineer Ram Manohar Maurya, have since retired. Vigilance has registered a case against them and continued its investigation. Sources say the alleged scam followed a pattern similar to the ₹5,000-crore NRHM scam reported in 2011.

stories.title: Rohini to enter politics to take revenge on Chandrashekhar:Writes ‘Switzerland to power’ on X; Ghavari working to unite the Valmiki community
stories.summary: It is said that everything is fair in love and war. Something similar appears to be unfolding between Azad Samaj Party president Chandrashekhar Azad and his former girlfriend Rohini Ghavari. Rohini once gave up everything to help establish Chandrashekhar in politics. Now, Ghavari is preparing to enter politics herself to take revenge on him. Having already drawn up a ‘Switzerland to power’ roadmap, Rohini is working to unite the Valmiki community. Her first test will come in the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. She may be seen aligning with the Samajwadi Party at the time. What is the reason behind her dispute with Chandrashekhar? What roadmap has Rohini prepared to enter politics? What did she discuss with SP chief Akhilesh Yadav? Read the Sunday Big Story… Rohini had already drawn up her political roadmap… Rohini Ghavari, the daughter of a sanitation worker from Indore, went to Switzerland to pursue her studies 6 years ago on a state government scholarship. Along with completing her PhD in Switzerland, she was also running the Janpower Foundation. On 11 September, Rohini left Switzerland and returned to India. Soon after returning, Rohini first visited the Valmiki Ashram at Bhagwan Valmiki Mandir Marg in Pachkuinya. She sought blessings there. This clearly signals that she plans to launch a nationwide campaign to unite the Valmiki community. She will begin with Uttar Pradesh, the country’s most populous state. Rohini has made her political goal clear. She aims to have the country’s first chief minister from the Valmiki community within the next five years. She says that a person from a community that has been confined to sanitation work for years must be placed in the highest position of power for true freedom to be achieved. Rohini said that if everyone in the country has had the opportunity to become a chief minister, why should the Valmiki community not have the same right? She said she wants to build political leadership and confidence among people from her community. According to Rohini, her next goal is to have a Valmiki community member become chief minister of a state within five years. Senior journalist Syed Qasim says that whether or not Rohini succeeds in becoming a chief minister, she has certainly attempted to awaken political ambition within the Valmiki community through this campaign. To politically mobilise a community, it is also important to give it a big dream. Rohini appears to be moving forward in the same direction. Rohini preparing to build political presence in 4 states, including Delhi Rohini Ghavari received a grand welcome in Delhi after returning to India. Karni Sena president Surajpal Singh Ammu, along with Hindu leaders Daksh Chaudhary and Akku Pandit, attended the event. She later met members of the Valmiki community. On 12th September, Rohini reached Gurugram, Haryana, where she again interacted with community members. On 13th September, she is scheduled to visit Meerut in Uttar Pradesh. The city is part of western UP, where her biggest political rival, Azad Samaj Party chief Chandrashekhar Azad, is strengthening his political base. Rohini will be in Lucknow on 14 September and may meet SP chief Akhilesh Yadav. She will stay there for two days and hold meetings with members of the Valmiki community. She will then travel to Indore on 16th September. Her itinerary indicates a strategy to mobilise the Valmiki community across Delhi, Haryana, UP and Madhya Pradesh. Rohini’s UP plan Rohini says she will raise issues of representation and social justice for Dalits, with a special focus on the Valmiki community. She is also questioning political representation and rights for the Jatav and Valmiki communities. She claims Dalits account for around 21% of Uttar Pradesh’s population, of which the Valmiki community makes up about 3.19%. She questions the community’s representation in government jobs and politics, saying Valmikis are still largely viewed only as sanitation workers. According to the information cited by Rohini, Valmiki voters have a significant influence in around 21 Assembly constituencies, including Agra Cantt, Etmadpur, Jasrana, Firozabad, Meerut Cantt, Meerut City, Ghaziabad, Loni, Lucknow Central, Lucknow North, Lucknow West, Sisamau, Arya Nagar, Kidwai Nagar, Aligarh, Kol and Khair. Rohini plans to be more active in these constituencies, most of which are in western UP. She will also hold meetings in areas where Chandrashekhar has influence and share her account of the alleged betrayal with the Jatav community. Rohini may be seen with the SP Rohini says Akhilesh Yadav was the only politician who supported her in her dispute with Chandrashekhar. According to her, Akhilesh heard her concerns and assured her of support. She is expected to meet him during her Lucknow visit, with discussions on her political roadmap also likely. On whether she will join the SP, Rohini says her primary aim is to fight for the rights of sanitation workers and give the Valmiki community a political identity. She says she is ready to do whatever is required for this. There is also speculation that Akhilesh could consider making her a candidate from a constituency. Plans to bring upper-caste communities into the campaign Rohini’s campaign appears to extend beyond the Valmiki community. She has openly challenged the Jatav community, saying she will see how many Jatavs support her movement. She has also spoken about bringing people from all communities together. Rohini says the Valmiki community does not insult anyone’s faith or Hindu gods and goddesses and claims that the community has always worked towards keeping the country united. Her welcome by Karni Sena members and the Valmiki community after returning to India is also being seen as a possible sign of her political expansion. Rather than limiting herself to Dalit politics, she appears to be seeking wider support across communities. Her support for reservation based on economic criteria is also being viewed in this context. Rohini has also spoken openly about what she calls the misuse of the SC/ST Act. She says casteism divides society, while justice unites it. She has called for a separate law to address caste discrimination and injustice within the Dalit community, while also supporting reservation for upper-caste communities on economic grounds. What is behind Rohini Ghavari’s dispute with Chandrashekhar? Rohini has accused Chandrashekhar of lying to her and promising marriage despite being married and having a child. She alleges that he physically and mentally exploited her. According to Rohini, she also provided financial support to help establish Chandrashekhar in politics. She says they had shared a dream of securing dignity for the Dalit community, but she learnt his “true face” after he became an MP. She further claims that she later learnt that Chandrashekhar had behaved similarly with several other women. She says she approached the National Commission for Women and Delhi’s Rohini police station, but alleges that no FIR was registered. Rohini has linked her campaign to the issue of caste-based justice. In a social media post, she questioned why an FIR was registered in the case of a Jatav woman when the accused was a Brahmin and several leaders, including those from the Congress and AAP, supported her, while no one stood by Rohini. She argued that in her case, the victim belonged to the marginalised Valmiki community, while the accused, Chandrashekhar, belonged to the Jatav community. Before returning to India, Rohini also wrote on social media that Chandrashekhar and the Bhim Army would be directly responsible if she was attacked. She said she would travel across different states, hold social meetings, and continue her campaign despite opposition.

stories.title: Elderly man stabbed to death outside Lucknow police station:Deceased had confronted a street vendor for driving on the wrong side
stories.summary: An elderly man was stabbed to death in front of Madiyaon police station in Lucknow on Saturday afternoon. His grandson was taking him on a bike to pay a bill when a handcart vendor came towards them from the wrong side. As soon as the grandson asked him, "Where are you coming from on this side?" the vendor became angry and attacked him with a knife. The grandfather, who was seated behind his grandson on the bike, got off to save him. The handcart vendor stopped attacking the grandson and began stabbing the grandfather instead. He stabbed the elderly man five times in the stomach and chest with full force, causing chunks of flesh to protrude. He collapsed and died at the scene. The incident took place at 1 pm under the flyover in front of Madiaon police station. See 2 pictures- Retired from the municipal corporation 16 years ago The elderly man was Magan Bihari Tiwari of Bharatnagar. He had retired from the municipal corporation around 16 years ago, in 2010. He had been a supervisor in the RR department. At around 1 p.m. on Saturday, he was heading to the power house with his grandson, Sankalp Tiwari, to pay a bill. On the way, Sankalp got into an argument with a scrap dealer who was arriving on a three-wheeled cart, in front of Madiyaon police station. During the argument, the scrap dealer attacked Sankalp with a knife. Magan Bihari stepped forward to save his grandson. The scrap dealer repeatedly stabbed him as well. The knife penetrated several places in his abdomen and chest. Chaos broke out at the scene. People informed the police. The scrap dealer fled before the police arrived. Eyewitnesses said Rajkumar alias Malai committed the murder Madiyaon police said eyewitnesses reported that 40-year-old Rajkumar alias Malai stabbed the grandfather and grandson. He currently lives around Markandeya Dharamshala in Keshavnagar and buys scrap from neighbourhoods. According to police, teams have been deployed to apprehend the scrap dealer. He will be arrested and questioned about the motive for the murders. Pradeep Tiwari, the son of Magan Bihari, is also a supervisor in Zone 2 of the municipal corporation. He said, "I was in the office when my mother called and told me that my father was unwell. She asked me to come to Highway Hospital. When I reached the spot, I learnt that someone had stabbed my father. He had gone out with his son, my nephew, to pay the electricity bill." Injured Grandson Is Studying in Intermediate, Daughter Reached Hospital Magan Bihari's family includes his wife, Maya Tiwari, son Pradeep Tiwari, daughter-in-law Pushpa, and three grandchildren. At the time of the incident, his eldest grandson, Sankalp Tiwari, was with him. He is currently studying in intermediate. The family has been inconsolable since the incident. After receiving the information, his elder daughter Poonam also reached the hospital. She broke down after seeing her father's body there.

stories.title: Ajay Rai picked up on way to meet trader’s family:He questions why Dhananjay was not arrested in the codeine case
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Congress president Ajay Rai was stopped by police while travelling to Gonda to meet the family of businessman Vinod Sahni, who was killed. He was travelling with a convoy of six vehicles on Saturday afternoon. Police stopped him beyond the Shahabpur toll plaza at the Barabanki border and did not allow him to proceed. Ajay Rai became angry and argued with the police. Angrily, he said: "If there is a written order, show it. Why are you stopping me from meeting the family? I am going to share the family's grief. What have you done to the strongman Dhananjay Singh in the codeine cough syrup case? You have not been able to arrest him to this day. You are stopping me." Ajay Rai remained adamant about proceeding. The police then detained him and brought him to Masoli police station. As soon as he reached the station, he sat on a sit-in protest. On learning this, around 200 Congress workers from Gonda and Barabanki also reached the police station. Congress workers continued the sit-in for around one and a half hours. At 3:30 p.m., Ajay Rai ended the protest after the police persuaded him and returned to Lucknow. See 3 pictures- Congress leader says - We will definitely meet the family Ajay Rai had announced on Friday that he would travel to Gonda. The police became alert after this. Barricades were put up at the Shahabpur toll plaza and 100 police personnel were deployed. When Ajay Rai's convoy arrived at 1:20 p.m., Circle Officer Colonelganj Narendra Pratap Rai and Kotwal Narendra Pratap stopped it. In addition, several Congress leaders in Gonda were placed under house arrest. Pramod Mishra, former Gonda Congress district president, said, "We will meet the family, but before that, the police have started harassing us. Under no circumstances will we be prevented from visiting the victim's family home." Now, understand the full matter Videos and photos of Dhananjay with a drug smuggler had emerged Photos and videos of strongman former MP Dhananjay Singh with drug smuggler Amit Tata, who was arrested in Lucknow around nine months ago, had surfaced. However, Dhananjay Singh later issued a clarification, saying that a conspiracy was being hatched against him and that the CBI should investigate the smuggling of codeine-mixed intoxicating syrup. Ajay Rai has targeted Dhananjay over this case.
